# Duties and Responsibilities

The implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners are subject to the provisions stipulated in the Articles of Association and the prevailing laws and regulations.

The Board of Commissioners has the duties and responsibilities as follows:

- Conducting supervision and being responsible for the controlling of management policy and the course of management in general, both regarding the Company and the Company's business, and providing advisory to the Board of Directors
- Providing the approval for the Company's annual work plan, at the latest before the commencement of the next financial year
- Performing tasks specifically assigned to him according to the Articles of Association, applicable laws and regulations and/or based on the decision of the General Meeting of Shareholders
- Performing duties, authorities, and responsibilities in accordance with the provisions of the Articles of Association of the Company and the resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders
- Examining and studying the annual report prepared by the Board of Directors and signing the annual report
- Complying with the Articles of Association and laws and regulations, and upholding the principles of professionalism, efficiency, transparency, independency, accountability, responsibility, and fairness
- Represent on behalf of Company in the event that the Company has conflict of interests with personal interests of all members of the Board of Directors (conflict of interest)
- Establish an Audit Committee, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and other committees in accordance with the requirements stipulated in the laws and regulations in the capital market
- Ensure the implementation of all Company policies that have been prepared related to nomination and remuneration processes, performance evaluation through self assessment for Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners, and the policies and criteria of succession/regeneration in the nomination of candidates of the Board of Directors and/or Board of Commissioners
- Establish policies and evaluate the Company's performance from a good, stable, growing and sustainable financial aspect
- Monitor the implementation of good corporate governance principles

# Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

Pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris tunduk pada ketentuan yang diatur dalam Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

Dewan Komisaris memiliki tugas dan tanggung jawab sebagai berikut:

- Melakukan pengawasan dan bertanggung jawab atas pengawasan terhadap kebijakan pengurusan dan jalannya pengurusan pada umumnya, baik mengenai Perseroan maupun usaha Perseroan, dan memberikan nasihat kepada Direksi
- Memberikan persetujuan atas rencana kerja tahunan Perseroan, selambat-lambatnya sebelum dimulainya tahun buku yang akan datang
- Melakukan tugas yang secara khusus diberikan kepadanya menurut Anggaran Dasar, peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan/atau berdasarkan keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham
- Melakukan tugas, wewenang, dan tanggung jawab sesuai dengan ketentuan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan dan keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham
- Meneliti dan menelaah laporan tahunan yang dipersiapkan oleh Direksi serta menandatangani laporan tahunan tersebut
- Mematuhi Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundangan-undangan, serta wajib melaksanakan prinsip-prinsip profesionalisme, efisiensi, transparansi, kemandirian, akuntabilitas, pertanggungjawaban, serta kewajaran
- Mewakili Perseroan dalam hal Perseroan mempunyai kepentingan yang bertentangan dengan kepentingan pribadi seluruh anggota Direksi (benturan kepentingan)
- Membentuk Komite Audit, Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi serta komite lainnya sesuai dengan persyaratan yang diatur dalam peraturan perundang-undangan di bidang Pasar Modal
- Memastikan dilaksanakannya segala kebijakan Perseroan yang telah disusun terkait dengan nominasi, remunerasi, evaluasi kinerja, penilaian sendiri (self assessment) bagi anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris, dan kebijakan dan kriteria suksesi/regenerasi dalam proses nominasi calon anggota Direksi dan/atau anggota Dewan Komisaris
- Menetapkan kebijakan dan melakukan penilaian kinerja Perseroan dari aspek keuangan yang baik, stabil, bertumbuh dan berkelanjutan
- Melakukan pemantauan atas penerapan prinsip tata kelola perusahaan yang baik

Board of Commissioners Charter
In supervising the Company's management, the Board of Commissioners follows the guideline from Board of Commissioners Charter which contains their duties, responsibilities, and authorities.

Assessment of the Performance of the Board of Commissioners
Referring to the Board of Commissioners Charter, the evaluation of the performance of the members of the Board of Commissioners is carried out by the Company's shareholders. The Company also has a Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Commissioners, in which this policy is prepared as a guideline that can be used to assess the effectiveness of the implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners and also as a form of accountability for the assessment of the performance of the Board of Commissioners of the Company.

Piagam Dewan Komisaris
Dalam mengawasi pengelolaan Perseroan, Dewan Komisaris berpedoman pada Piagam Dewan Komisaris yang memuat tugas, tanggung jawab dan wewenang Dewan Komisaris.

Penilaian terhadap Kinerja Dewan Komisaris
Mengacu pada Piagam Dewan Komisaris (Board of Commissioners Charter), penilaian atas kinerja anggota Dewan Komisaris dilakukan oleh pemegang saham Perseroan. Perseroan juga telah memiliki Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Dewan Komisaris, yang mana kebijakan tersebut disusun sebagai pedoman yang dapat digunakan untuk menilai efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris dan juga sebagai bentuk akuntabilitas atas penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris Perseroan.

The Company's shareholders periodically evaluate the performance of the Board of Commissioners at least once a year. Performance appraisal is carried out on the implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners in supervising and managing the Company as stated in the laws and regulations and the Company's Articles of Association.

In addition, based on the Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Commissioners applicable in the Company, the following are the provisions for the Board of Commissioners performance assessment:

01. Performance appraisal of the Board of Commissioners is performed using self-assessment every year collegially
02. Performance appraisal of each member of the Board of Commissioners is performed by the President Commissioner every year based on role and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners
03. Each member of the Board of Commissioners conducts a self-assessment, then the results are consolidated for joint review by all members of the Board of Commissioners in order to determine the effectiveness of the Board of Commissioners and the areas that need improvement
04. The Board of Commissioners prepares the corrective actions, and the President Commissioner ensures the implementation of the corrective actions
05. Performance appraisal of the Board of Commissioners is conducted by considering several components, which include structure and composition of the Board of Commissioners, strategy implementation and company management, the effectiveness of the committee, risk management implementation and internal control, and the implementation of Good Corporate Governance

The Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Commissioners also regulates the aspects of the Board of Commissioners' assessment. These aspects of the assessment are among others:

01. Supervise the management of the Company performed by the Board of Directors
02. Review, examine, and approve the Annual Work Plan of the Company
03. Carry out special tasks assigned to the member(s) of the Board of Commissioners in accordance with the Articles of Association, applicable laws and regulations and/or resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders
04. Perform his/her duties and responsibilities in accordance with the provisions of the Articles of Association and the resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders
05. Comply with the Articles of the Association and the prevailing laws and regulations and be obliged to perform duties based on principles of professionalism, efficiency, transparency, independency, accountability, responsibility and fairness, among others to convey the BOC meeting in accordance with the applicable regulations

Pemegang saham Perseroan secara berkala melakukan evaluasi atas kinerja Dewan Komisaris setidaknya satu kali dalam setahun. Penilaian kinerja dilakukan terhadap pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris dalam mengawasi dan mengelola Perseroan sebagaimana yang tercantum dalam peraturan perundang-undangan dan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan.

Di samping itu, berdasarkan Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Dewan Komisaris yang berlaku di Perseroan, maka di bawah ini merupakan ketentuan atas penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris:

01. Penilaian Kinerja Dewan Komisaris dilakukan dengan metode self-assessment setiap tahun secara kolegial
02. Penilaian kinerja Anggota Dewan Komisaris dilakukan oleh Komisaris Utama setiap tahun berdasarkan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris
03. Masing-masing anggota Dewan Komisaris melakukan self-assessment, kemudian hasilnya dikonsolidasi untuk ditinjau bersama oleh seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris guna menetapkan efektivitas dari Dewan Komisaris beserta area-area yang perlu dilakukan perbaikan
04. Dewan Komisaris menyusun rencana tindak lanjut perbaikan dan Komisaris Utama memastikan pelaksanaan rencana perbaikan tersebut
05. Penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris dilakukan dengan mempertimbangkan beberapa komponen, antara lain: struktur dan komposisi Dewan Komisaris, pelaksanaan strategi dan pengelolaan perusahaan, efektivitas pelaksanaan program kerja komite, penerapan manajemen risiko dan pengendalian internal, serta penerapan prinsip Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik

Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Dewan Komisaris juga mengatur perihal aspek-aspek penilaian Dewan Komisaris. Aspek-aspek penilaian tersebut antara lain:

01. Mengawasi pengurusan Perseroan yang dilaksanakan oleh Direksi
02. Meninjau, memeriksa, dan menyetujui Rencana Kerja Tahunan Perseroan
03. Melakukan tugas khusus yang diberikan kepada anggota Dewan Komisaris sesuai dengan Anggaran Dasar, hukum dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan/atau keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham
04. Melakukan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya sesuai dengan ketentuan-ketentuan Anggaran Dasar dan keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham

Mematuhi Anggaran Dasar serta hukum dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan wajib melaksanakan tugasnya sesuai dengan prinsip-prinsip profesionalisme, efisiensi, transparansi, independensi, akuntabilitas, pertanggungjawaban dan kewajaran, antara lain melaksanakan Rapat Dewan Komisaris sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku

Direksi

The Board of Directors' responsibility in corporate management is aimed at creating added value and ensuring business continuity. The Board of Directors is in charge and responsible collectively for managing the Company. Each Director performs its duties and makes decisions in accordance with the division of duties and authorities. Duties, and other matters related to the Board of Directors must be in accordance with the Articles of Association and prevailing laws and regulations.

The Board of Directors is one of the Company's main organ that holds full responsibility of corporate management in accordance with the Articles of Association. In conducting its duties, the Board of Directors is responsible to the GMS. This responsibility is a manifestation of corporate management accountability in the implementation of GCG principles.

Each member of the Board of Directors may perform their decision-making duty under the segregation of duties and authorities of the Board of Directors. However, the performance of duties of each member of the Board of Directors remains a collective responsibility. The President Director has to coordinate the activities of the Board of Directors.

## Structure and Composition of the Board of Directors

All members of the Board of Directors are experienced in their fields and understand all of the Company's business lines properly and correctly.

The composition and number of members of the Board of Directors are determined by the GMS which taking into account the Company's vision and mission to enable effective, precise, fast and accountable decision-making, as well as in order for carrying out the Company's operations with full strategy.

## Duties and Authorities of Board of Directors

The implementation of the duties and authorities of the Board of Directors are subject to the provisions stipulated in the Articles of Association and the prevailing laws and regulations.

The Board of Directors has the duties and responsibilities in accordance with Articles of Association of the Company as follows:

01. The Board of Directors is in charge of carrying out and being responsible for the management of the Company in all aspects, and for the best interests of the Company in accordance with the purposes and objectives of the Company as stipulated in the Articles of Association. In carrying out the duties and responsibilities of managing the Company, the Board of Directors is supervised by the Board of Commissioners

02. In carrying out the duties and responsibilities for management, the Board of Directors is required to hold an Annual GMS and other GMS as stipulated in the laws and regulations and the Articles of Association and submit the accountability report on its management to the Shareholders through such GMS

03. Each member of the Board of Directors must carry out their duties and responsibilities in good faith, full of responsibility and prudence

04. The Board of Directors is obliged to secure, manage and strive to improve the Company's valuable assets

05. The Board of Directors has the right to represent the Company inside and outside the Court on all matters and in all events, bind the Company to other parties and other parties to the Company, and carry out all actions regarding decision and ownership, but with the limitation that for certain matters, the Board of Directors must obtain prior approval from the Company's Board of Commissioners, namely:

## Tugas dan Wewenang Direksi

Pelaksanaan tugas dan wewenang Direksi tunduk pada ketentuan yang diatur dalam Anggaran Dasar dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

Direksi memiliki tugas dan wewenang Direksi sesuai Anggaran Dasar Perseroan yakni sebagai berikut:

01. Direksi bertugas menjalankan dan bertanggung jawab atas pengurusan Perseroan di segala aspek, dan untuk kepentingan terbaik Perseroan sesuai dengan maksud dan tujuan Perseroan yang ditetapkan dalam Anggaran Dasar. Dalam menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawab atas pengurusan Perseroan, Direksi diawasi oleh Dewan Komisaris

02. Direksi wajib menyelenggarakan RUPS Tahunan dan RUPS lainnya sebagaimana diatur dalam peraturan perundang-undangan dan Anggaran Dasar, dan menyampaikan laporan pertanggungjawaban atas pengurusannya kepada para Pemegang Saham melalui RUPS tersebut

03. Setiap anggota Direksi wajib melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya dengan itikad baik, penuh tanggung jawab, dan kehati-hatian

04. Direksi wajib mengamankan, mengelola, dan berupaya meningkatkan aset-aset berharga Perseroan

05. Direksi berhak mewakili Perseroan di dalam dan di luar Pengadilan tentang segala hal dan dalam segala kejadian, mengikat Perseroan dengan pihak lain dan pihak lain dengan Perseroan, serta menjalankan segala tindakan baik yang mengenai kepengurusan maupun kepemilikan, akan tetapi dengan pembatasan bahwa untuk hal-hal tertentu, Direksi harus memperoleh persetujuan terlebih dahulu dari Dewan Komisaris Perseroan, yakni:

a. Borrowing or lending money on behalf of the Company (excluding withdrawing Company's money from the banks) which amount is in excess of the limit as determined by the Board of Commissioners from time to time
b. Establishing a business entity or participating in other companies, both in Indonesia or outside Indonesia
c. Binding the Company as guarantor
d. Purchase or dispose of the Company's assets for a value equal to or above 50% (fifty percent) of the Company's total equity

However, the involvement of the Board of Commissioners does not negate the responsibility of the Board of Directors for the management of the Company.

06. The Board of Directors must meet the requirements specified in the Capital Market regulations in carrying out actions that constitute material transactions and/or conflicts of interest as referred to in the applicable Capital Market regulations.
07. Members of the Board of Directors are not authorized to represent the Company if there is a case in court between the Company and the member of the Board of Directors concerned.
08. If something happens where the interests of the Company conflict with the personal interests of a member of the Board of Directors (conflict of interest), the Company will be represented by another member of the Board of Directors who does not have a conflict of interest.

In the event that the Company has interests that conflict with personal interests of all members of the Board of Directors (conflict of interest), then the Company will be represented by the Board of Commissioners.

When the Company suffers a loss, each member of the Board of Directors is jointly and severally responsible for the Company's losses caused by the mistakes or negligence of members of the Board of Directors in carrying out their duties. However, member(s) of the Board of Directors is not required to fulfill these responsibilities if he/she can prove the following:

01. The loss was not due to his/her fault or negligence
02. He/she has conducted management in good faith, full of responsibility and prudence for the benefit of the Company and in accordance with the aims and objectives of the Company
03. He/she has no conflict of interest, either directly or indirectly, for the management actions that resulted in the loss; and
04. He/she has taken action to prevent the loss or the continuation of the loss

a. Meminjam atau meminjamkan uang atas nama Perseroan (tidak termasuk pengambilan uang Perseroan di bank-bank) yang jumlahnya melebihi batasan sebagaimana ditetapkan oleh Dewan Komisaris dari waktu ke waktu
b. Mendirikan suatu usaha atau turut serta pada perusahaan lain baik di dalam maupun di luar negeri

c. Mengikat Perseroan sebagai penjamin
d. Membeli atau melepaskan aset Perseroan untuk nilai setara atau di atas 50% (lima puluh persen) dari total ekuitas Perseroan

Namun demikian, keterlibatan Dewan Komisaris tersebut tidak menjadi gang yang dimaksud dalam pelaksanaan kepengurusan Perseroan.

06. Direksi harus memenuhi persyaratan yang ditentukan dalam peraturan Pasar Modal dalam melaksanakan tindakan yang merupakan transaksi material dan/atau benturan kepentingan yang dimaksud dalam peraturan Pasar Modal yang berlaku.
07. Anggota Direksi tidak berwenang mewakili Perseroan apabila terdapat perkara di pengadilan antara Perseroan dengan anggota Direksi yang bersangkutan.
08. Apabila terjadi sesuatu hal dimana kepentingan Perseroan bertentangan dengan kepentingan pribadi salah satu anggota Direksi (benturan kepentingan), Perseroan akan diwakili oleh anggota Direksi lainnya yang tidak mempunyai benturan kepentingan.

Dalam hal Perseroan mempunyai kepentingan yang bertentangan dengan kepentingan pribadi seluruh anggota Direksi (benturan kepentingan), maka dalam hal tersebut Perseroan akan diwakili oleh Dewan Komisaris.

Ketika Perseroan mengalami kerugian, setiap anggota Direksi bertanggung jawab secara tanggung renteng atas kerugian Perseroan yang disebabkan oleh kesalahan atau kelalaian anggota Direksi dalam menjalankan tugasnya. Namun, anggota Direksi tidak perlu untuk memenuhi tanggung jawab tersebut apabila ia dapat membuktikan hal-hal sebagai berikut:

01. Kerugian tersebut bukan karena kesalahan atau kelalaiannya
02. Ia telah melakukan pengurusan dengan itikad baik, penuh tanggung jawab, dan kehati-hatian untuk kepentingan Perseroan dan sesuai dengan maksud dan tujuan Perseroan
03. Ia tidak mempunyai benturan kepentingan baik langsung maupun tidak langsung atas tindakan pengurusan yang mengakibatkan kerugian tersebut; dan
04. Ia telah mengambil tindakan untuk mencegah timbulnya kerugian atau berlanjutnya kerugian tersebut

Further, members of the Board of Directors shall, in performing their duties and responsibilities, be required to comply with the Code of Conducts of the Company and are prohibited from taking personal advantages, both directly and indirectly, from the Company's activities other than salaries and other benefits which they are legally entitled to, including the retirement benefits they receive as members of Board of Directors in accordance with the prevailing laws and regulations. The President Director is obliged to ensure compliance of all members of the Board of Directors with the Code of Conduct of the Company, including settling any conflicts that may arise.

## Division of Duties among the Directors

The distribution of duties and authorities for each member of the Board of Directors is determined by the GMS. In the event that the GMS does not stipulate such matter, the division of duties and authorities of members of the Board of Directors will be determined based on the decision of the Board of Directors.

In order to support effective implementation of the Board of Directors duties, duties have been allocated among the members of the Board of Directors. The assignments are based on the expertise and experience of each member, with the aim of supporting an accurate and quick decision-making process.

The President Director has the right and authority to act on behalf of the Board of Directors and represent the Company. In the event that the President Director is absent or unable to attend due to any reason, which does not need to be proven to a third party, then other members of the Board of Directors have the right and authority to act for and on behalf of the Board of Directors and represent them.

Lebih lanjut, anggota Direksi, dalam menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya, wajib mematuhi Kode Etik Perusahaan dan dilarang mengambil keuntungan pribadi baik langsung maupun tidak langsung dari kegiatan Perusahaan selain gaji dan tunjangan lain yang menjadi haknya secara sah, termasuk tunjangan pensiun yang diterimanya sebagai anggota Direksi sesuai dengan peraturan perundang- undangan yang berlaku. Presiden Direktur wajib memastikan kepatuhan seluruh anggota Direksi terhadap Kode Etik Perusahaan, termasuk menyelesaikan setiap konflik yang mungkin timbul.

## Pembagian Tugas di antara Direksi

Pembagian tugas dan wewenang setiap anggota Direksi ditetapkan oleh RUPS. Dalam hal RUPS tidak menetapkan, maka pembagian tugas dan wewenang anggota Direksi akan ditetapkan berdasarkan keputusan Direksi.

Untuk mendukung efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas Direksi, telah dialokasikan tugas di antara anggota Direksi. Penugasan didasarkan pada keahlian dan pengalaman masing-masing anggota, dengan tujuan untuk mendukung proses pengambilan keputusan yang akurat dan cepat.

Presiden Direktur berhak dan berwenang bertindak atas nama Direksi serta mewakili Perseroan. Dalam hal Presiden Direktur tidak hadir atau berhalangan untuk hadir karena sebab apapun juga, hal mana tidak perlu dibuktikan kepada pihak ketiga, maka anggota Direksi lainnya berhak dan berwenang bertindak untuk dan atas nama Direksi serta mewakili.

# Board of Directors Charter

In managing the Company, the Board of Directors follows the guideline from Board of Directors Charter which was inaugurated on June 9, 2015 which contains the work guidelines and rules, authority, duties, responsibilities, obligations, division of tasks, meetings, provisions on conflicts of interest, share ownership, mechanism arrangements and division of labor between members of the Board of Directors which are not regulated in the Company's Articles of Association or applicable laws and regulations. With the existence of the Board of Directors Charter, it is hoped that the performance of the Board of Directors will be more focused and in synergy with one another.

The Board of Directors Charter has been formulated based on the prevailing rules and regulations in Indonesia, and is evaluated periodically to ensure its suitability with the development of the Company and the business environment.

# Assessment of the Performance of the Board of Directors

Referring to the Board of Directors Charter, the evaluation of the performance of the members of the Board of Directors is carried out by the Board Of Commissioners and shareholders of the Company. The Company also has a Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Directors, in which this policy is prepared as a guideline that can be used to assess the effectiveness of the implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Directors and also as a form of accountability for the performance assessment of the Board of Directors of the Company.

The Board of Directors Charter contains an explanation of the method for evaluating the performance of members of the Board of Directors, which include the following:

01. The Board of Commissioners will determine the Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

02. The Board of Commissioners will evaluate the performance achievements of the members of the Board of Directors which will then be submitted to the shareholders at the General Meeting of Shareholders ("GMS")

03. The performance evaluation of the members of the Board of Directors will be carried out based on the following KPIs:

- Achievement of the Board of Directors' performance (collectively) by looking at the Company's achievements based on the Business Plan and Annual Operational Plan, and/or other criteria determined by the Board of Commissioners
- Achievement of the performance of the Board of Directors (individually) in achieving the Company's performance as stated in the Business Plan and Annual Operational Plan, Management Contract, and or other criteria determined in the Board of Commissioners meeting
- Implementation of Good Corporate Governance principles, both individually and collectively

# Piagam Direksi

Dalam mengelola Perseroan, Direksi berpedoman pada Piagam Direksi yang diresmikan pada tanggal 9 Juni 2015, yang memuat pedoman dan tata tertib kerja, wewenang, tugas, tanggung jawab, kewajiban, pembagian tugas, rapat, ketentuan benturan kepentingan, kepemilikan saham, pengaturan mekanisme dan pembagian kerja antar para anggota Direksi yang tidak diatur di dalam Anggaran Dasar Perseroan maupun ketentuan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Dengan adanya Piagam Direksi, diharapkan kinerja Direksi lebih terarah dan bersinergi satu sama lain.

Piagam Direksi tersebut telah diformulasikan berdasarkan ketentuan dan peraturan yang berlaku di Indonesia, serta dievaluasi secara periodik untuk memastikan kesesuaiannya dengan perkembangan Perseroan dan lingkungan usaha.

# Penilaian terhadap kinerja Direksi

Mengacu pada Piagam Direksi (Board of Directors Charter), penilaian atas kinerja anggota Direksi dilakukan oleh Dewan Komisaris dan pemegang saham Perseroan. Perseroan juga telah memiliki Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Direksi, yang mana kebijakan ini disusun sebagai pedoman yang dapat digunakan untuk menilai efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Direksi dan juga sebagai bentuk akuntabilitas atas penilaian kinerja Direksi Perseroan.

Piagam Direksi (Board of Directors Charter) memuat penjelasan mengenai metode evaluasi/penilaian kinerja atas anggota Direksi, yang mana di antaranya adalah sebagai berikut:

01. Dewan Komisaris akan menetapkan Indikator Kinerja Utama/ Key Performance Indicator (KPI)

02. Dewan Komisaris akan melakukan evaluasi atas pencapaian kinerja dari anggota Direksi yang mana selanjutnya akan disampaikan pada pemegang saham dalam Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham ("RUPS")

03. Evaluasi kinerja anggota Direksi tersebut akan dilakukan berdasarkan KPI sebagai berikut:

- Pencapaian kinerja Direksi (secara bersama-sama) dengan melihat pencapaian Perseroan berdasarkan Rencana Bisnis dan Rencana Operasional Tahunan, dan/atau kriteria lainnya yang ditetapkan oleh Dewan Komisaris
- Pencapaian kinerja Direksi (secara individu) dalam mencapai kinerja Perusahaan Perseroan sebagaimana tercantum dalam Rencana Bisnis dan, Rencana Operasional Tahunan, Kontrak Manajemen, dan atau kriteria lainnya yang ditetapkan dalam rapat Dewan Komisaris
- Implementasi prinsip-prinsip Tata Kelola yang Baik (Good Corporate Governance), baik secara individu maupun kolektif

In addition, the Board of Directors performance appraisal is also stipulated in the Board of Directors Performance Assessment Policy, namely:

01. All members of the Board of Directors have performance goals based on the duties and responsibilities of each member
02. Performance appraisal of the Board of Directors is conducted every year by the President Director
03. Performance appraisal results of the Board of Directors is reported to the Board of Commissioners through the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.

The Board of Directors' Performance Assessment Policy also regulates the aspects of the Board of Directors' assessment. These aspects include:

01. Lead, manage, and control the Company in accordance with the purpose of the Company
02. Make effort to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of the Company
03. Prepare an annual work plan containing the annual budget of the Company and submit the plan to the Board of Commissioner to obtain approval before the beginning of the following fiscal year

Audit Committee

Komite Audit

The Company formed the Audit Committee with the aim of assisting the Board of Commissioners in carrying out the oversight function. The Audit Committee is tasked with ensuring that the Company is managed with sound management in accordance with GCG principles and applicable laws and regulations. In addition, the Audit Committee is required to provide advice to the Board of Commissioners regarding the implementation of internal control and company audits, make a written report on each special assignment mandated by the Board of Commissioners, and make reports on the implementation of each audit activity carried out by the Audit Committee in the Company and its subsidiaries, including the level of achievement of the performance of the Audit Committee. The activities and performance of the Audit Committee must be disclosed in the Company's Annual Report.

The Company's Audit Committee is appointed based on the decision of the Board of Commissioners and responsible to the Board of Commissioners in assisting and carrying out the duties and functions of the Board of Commissioners.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

Komite Audit bertugas dan bertanggung jawab memberikan pendapat profesional dan independen kepada Dewan Komisaris atas laporan atau hal-hal yang disampaikan oleh Direksi maupun Unit Audit Internal dan melaksanakan tugas-tugas lainnya yang berkaitan dengan tugas Dewan Komisaris. Untuk melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya, Komite Audit harus memahami ruang lingkup, tugas dan tanggung jawab pekerjaannya, yakni sebagai berikut:

01. Reviewing financial information that will be issued by the Company to the public and/or authorities, including financial reports, projections and other reports related to the Company's financial information

02. Reviewing compliance with laws and regulations relating to the Company's activities

03. Providing independent opinion in the event of disagreements between management and Accountants for the services rendered

04. Providing recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding the appointment of an Accountant based on independence, scope of work and service fees

05. Reviewing the implementation of the audit by the internal auditor and supervising the follow-up implementation by the Board of Directors on the findings of the internal auditor

06. Reviewing the risk management implementation activities carried out by the Board of Directors

07. Reviewing any complaints relating to the accounting process and financial reporting of the Company

08. Reviewing the independence and objectivity of the public accountants appointed by the Company

09. Reviewing the adequacy of audits conducted by public accountants

10. Examining allegations of any faults in the decisions of the Board of Directors meeting or irregularities in the implementation of the Board of Directors meeting resolutions

11. Delivering the review report to all members of the Board of Commissioners of the Company after the completion of the review report conducted by the Audit Committee

12. Reviewing and providing advice to the Board of Commissioners regarding potential conflicts of interest in the Company

13. Maintaining the confidentiality of the Company's documents, data and information

14. Evaluating the effectiveness of the implementation of the main tasks and functions of the Internal Audit Unit and the internal auditors of the Company and its subsidiaries.

01. Melakukan penelaahan atas informasi keuangan yang akan dikeluarkan Perseroan kepada publik dan/atau pihak otoritas, antara lain laporan keuangan, proyeksi dan laporan lainnya terkait dengan informasi keuangan Perseroan

# Nomination and Remuneration Committee

Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee is a committee that is established to support the implementation of the duties of the Board of Commissioners which is appointed based on the decision of the Board of Commissioners and responsible to the Board of Commissioners and shall acts independently in carrying out its duties and responsibilities.

The establishment of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee refers to OJK Regulation No. 34/POJK.04/2015 concerning the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of Issuers or Public Companies. With the existence of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the Company wishes that the process of selecting and making remuneration policies can be carried out in accordance with professional and independent considerations, honest and fair, and without any pressure from any party.

## Guidelines for the Nomination and Remuneration Committee

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee is guided by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee Guidelines which generally contain the followings: (i) composition and membership structure, (ii) term of office, (iii) duties and responsibilities, (iv) work methods and procedures, (v) policy on organizing meetings, (vi) activity reporting system, and (vii) procedures for replacing members of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, as outlined in the Decree of the Company's Board of Commissioners Number 08/SK-Dekom/SGH/VI/2020 dated June 19, 2020 regarding the Establishment of the Company's Nomination and Remuneration Committee Charter.

Complete information regarding the Charter of Company's Nomination and Remuneration Committee is available on the page of Company's website:

Pembentukan Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi mengacu pada Peraturan OJK No. 34/POJK.04/2015 tentang Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi Emiten atau Perusahaan Publik. Internal Audit Unit

Unit Audit Internal

The Internal Audit Unit was formed based on the Decree of the Board of Directors Number 05/SK-Dir/SGH/VI/2020 about the Establishment of the Company's Internal Audit Unit dated June 19, 2020.

The Internal Audit Unit is a supporting division to the Board of Directors that is responsible for monitoring and evaluating internal controls, as well as providing independent and objective assurance and consultations to create added value and improve operational performance.

The Internal Audit Unit is responsible to the President Director and acts independently in carrying out its duties and responsibilities. The Internal Audit Unit has unrestricted access to all functions and records within the Company, to fully carry out its mandate.

Patrick Lian Abuan Go was appointed as Head of the Internal Audit Unit based on the Decree of the Board of Directors Number 07/SK-Dir/SGH/VI/2020 about the Appointment of Head of Internal Audit Unit dated June 19, 2020.

The detailed biography of the Head of Internal Audit Unit can be seen in the the Company Profile section.

## Internal Audit Unit Charter

The Internal Audit Unit is guided by the Internal Audit Unit Charter which contains the vision and mission, scope of work, duties, responsibilities, authorities and Code of Ethics of the Internal Audit Unit, which is outlined in the Decree of the Board of Directors Number 06/SK-Dir/SGH/VI/2020 dated June 19, 2020 about the Charter of Internal Audit Unit.

## Duties and Responsibilities

The Internal Audit Unit reports directly to the President Director, the Board of Directors, Board of Commissioners and Audit Committee. The Internal Audit Unit is an independent unit within the Company.

The scope of duties and responsibilities of the Internal Audit Unit are as follows:

01. Prepare and implement annual Internal Audit plans
02. Test and evaluate the implementation of internal control and management system in accordance with Company policy
03. To conduct examination and assessment of the efficiency and effectiveness of finance, accounting, operations, human resources, marketing, information technology and other activities
04. Provide suggestions for improvements and objective information on the activities examined at all levels of management

Unit Audit Internal dibentuk berdasarkan Keputusan Direksi Perseroan Nomor 05/SK-Dir/SGH/VI/2020 tentang Pembentukan Unit Audit Internal Perseroan tertanggal 19 Juni 2020.

Unit Audit Internal merupakan divisi pendukung dari Direksi yang bertanggung jawab untuk melaksanakan pemantauan dan evaluasi atas pengendalian internal, serta memberikan keyakinan dan konsultasi yang bersifat independen dan objektif guna meningkatkan nilai tambah dan kinerja operasional.

Unit Audit Internal bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden Direktur dan bertindak secara independen dalam melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya. Unit Audit Internal memiliki akses tidak terbatas ke semua fungsi dan catatan di dalam Perusahaan, agar dapat menjalankan amanatnya secara penuh.

Patrick Lian Abuan Go diangkat sebagai Kepala Unit Audit Internal berdasarkan Surat Keputusan Direksi Perseroan Nomor 07/SK-Dir/SGH/VI/2020 tentang Pengangkatan/Penunjukan Kepala Unit Audit Internal Perseroan tertanggal 19 Juni 2020.

Profil lengkap Kepala Unit Audit Internal dapat dilihat di bagian Profil Perusahaan.

## Piagam Unit Audit Internal

Unit Audit Internal berpedoman pada Piagam Unit Audit Internal yang memuat visi dan misi, ruang lingkup pekerjaan, tugas, tanggung jawab, wewenang dan Kode Etik Unit Audit Internal, yang dituangkan di dalam Surat Keputusan Direksi Perseroan Nomor 06/SK-Dir/SGH/VI/2020 tanggal 19 Juni 2020 tentang Piagam Unit Audit Internal Perseroan.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

Unit Audit Internal bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Presiden Direktur, Direksi, Dewan Komisaris dan Komite Audit. Unit Audit Internal adalah unit yang bersifat independen di dalam Perseroan.

Ruang Lingkup tugas dan tanggung jawab Unit Audit Internal adalah sebagai berikut:

01. Menyusun dan melaksanakan rencana Audit Internal tahunan
02. Menguji dan mengevaluasi pelaksanaan pengendalian internal dan sistem manajemen sesuai dengan kebijakan Perseroan
03. Melakukan pemeriksaan dan penilaian atas efisiensi dan efektivitas di bidang keuangan, akuntansi, operasional, sumber daya manusia, pemasaran, teknologi informasi dan kegiatan lainnya
04. Memberikan saran perbaikan dan informasi yang objektif tentang kegiatan yang diperiksa pada semua tingkat manajemen

05. Prepare an audit report and submit the report to the President Director, Board of Commissioners and the Audit Committee
06. Monitor, analyze and report on the implementation of the suggested improvements
07. Liaise with the Audit Committee
08. Develop a program to evaluate the quality of the performance of its internal audit activities
09. Assist in significant fraud investigations
10. Conduct special audit, if needed

Sekretaris Perusahaan

The Corporate Secretary is appointed based on the Decree of Board of Directors and is responsible to the Board of Directors of the Company.

Yuliana was appointed as the Corporate Secretary based on the Decree of the Directors of the Company Number 01/SK-Dir/SGH/VI/2020 concerning the Appointment of the Corporate Secretary of the Company on June 19, 2020. Her biography can be seen in the Profile of the Board of Directors.

## Duties and Responsibilities

The Corporate Secretary reports directly to the Board of Directors.

The scope of duties and responsibilities of the Corporate Secretary are as follows:

01. Keep abreast of developments in the capital market, particularly the prevailing laws and regulations in the capital market
02. Provide input to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners of the Company to comply with the provisions of laws and regulations in the Capital Market sector
03. Assist the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners in implementing good corporate governance, which includes:

a. Disclosure of information to the public, including the availability of information on the Company's website
b. Submission of reports to the Financial Services Authority on time
c. Organizing and documenting the General Meeting of Shareholders
d. Organizing and documenting the meetings of the Board of Directors and/or the Board of Commissioners; and
e. Implementation of a company orientation program for the Board of Directors and/or the Board of Commissioners

04. As a liaison or contact person between the Company and the shareholders of the Company, the Financial Services Authority, and other stakeholders
05. Providing access to the public for all relevant information regarding the current condition of the Company.

# Anti-Bribery and Corruption Policies

Gratifikasi dan Kebijakan Anti Korupsi

In January 2014 the Company established an anti-corruption and bribery policy, in order to comply with the Anti-Corruption and Gratification Act of 1999 and 2001 and as part of our good corporate governance initiative, with the following objectives:

01. Create awareness to prevent potential financial and non-financial losses, including acts that can damage the Corporate reputation
02. Establish a policy and process that will protect the whistleblower from the retaliation from internal or external parties who were reported
03. Avoid or reduce potential Company's losses that will be incurred due to violations, by implementing of early detection; and
04. Improve the Company's reputation

This policy supplements the Company's code of business ethics and conduct by providing specific guidance about receiving and giving items of value which may violate the above regulations resulting to sanctions and reputation damage to the Company.

In the case of gratification, employees, under certain conditions, may be allowed to receive gifts/rewards from third parties on condition that the employee is obliged to report to the relevant parties and the Compliance Division that if the gift/reward is refused, then the refusal may be considered or may result in insult.

The Company has a whistleblowing system to support reports about possible violation of the above policy which are handled with full anonimity and protection from retaliaton.

Throughout 2022, there were some instances of reported receipt of small gifts by company employees, which were consulted to and assessed by our compliance officer. There was no reported instance which violate the above policy.

Pada bulan Januari 2014, Perseroan menetapkan kebijakan anti korupsi dan penyuapan, untuk mematuhi Undang-Undang Anti-Korupsi dan Gratifikasi tahun 1999 dan 2001 dan sebagai bagian dari inisiatif tata kelola perusahaan yang baik, dengan tujuan sebagai berikut:

01. Menciptakan kesadaran untuk mencegah potensi kerugian finansial maupun non-finansial, termasuk hal-hal yang dapat merusak reputasi Perseroan
02. Membangun suatu kebijakan dan proses yang akan melindungi pelapor dari upaya pembalasan dari pihak-pihak internal maupun eksternal yang dilaporkan
03. Menghindari atau mengurangi potensi kerugian Perseroan yang akan timbul karena adanya pelanggaran, dengan melakukan deteksi dini; dan
04. Meningkatkan reputasi Perseroan

Kebijakan ini melengkapi kode etik dan perilaku bisnis Perseroan dengan memberikan panduan khusus tentang penerimaan dan pemberian barang berharga yang dapat melanggar ketentuan di atas yang mengakibatkan sanksi dan kerusakan reputasi bagi Perseroan.

Dalam hal gratifikasi, karyawan, pada kondisi tertentu, mungkin diperbolehkan menerima hadiah/imbalan dari pihak ketiga dengan syarat karyawan tersebut wajib melaporkan kepada pihak terkait dan Divisi Kepatuhan bahwa apabila hadiah/imbalan tersebut ditolak, maka penolakan tersebut dapat dianggap atau dapat menimbulkan penghinaan.

Perseroan memiliki sistem whistleblowing untuk mendukung laporan tentang kemungkinan pelanggaran kebijakan di atas yang ditangani dengan anonimitas penuh dan perlindungan dari pembalasan.

Sepanjang tahun 2022, ada beberapa penerimaan hadiah kecil yang dilaporkan oleh karyawan Perseroan, yang dikonsultasikan dan dinilai oleh petugas kepatuhan kami. Tidak ada kasus yang dilaporkan yang melanggar kebijakan di atas.

# Whistleblowing System

Sistem Pelaporan Pelanggaran

## Whistleblowing System

In 2014, a whistleblowing system policy was issued in line with the Company's core value of absolute integrity. This policy led to the establishment of a whistleblowing hotline which is clear and easily accessible by all Company employees, where suspected and actual violation of the Code of Business Ethics and Conduct may be reported.

Some of the benefits obtained by implementing whistleblowing within Company are:

1. Having a platform for the Company to convey important and critical information to parties who must immediately handle those information safely in accordance with the whistleblowing principles
2. Building attitude and awareness of rejecting or avoiding violating acts, as well as a commitment to raise the willingness to report violations, which is built upon the trust in a reporting system that assures confidentiality and effectiveness
3. Providing an early warning system for possible issues to emerge due to a violation
4. Providing an opportunity to deal with violations acts internally first, before becomes a public violation issue

Reducing the risks faced by the organization, as a result of violations regarding finances, operations, law, relations with the government, occupational safety, and reputation

5. Reducing costs in dealing with the consequences of violations
6. Strengthening the Company's reputation among stakeholders, including regulators, and the public
7. Providing inputs to the Company to further monitor the critical areas and work processes with weak internal control, as well as to design the necessary improvement actions; and
8. Simplifying the bureaucratic procedures in following up on serious alleged violations that require quick responses

## Sistem Pelaporan Pelanggaran

Pada tahun 2014 telah dikeluarkan kebijakan sistem whistleblowing yang sejalan dengan nilai inti integritas mutlak Perseroan. Kebijakan ini mengarah pada pembentukan hotline whistleblowing yang jelas dan mudah diakses oleh semua karyawan Perseroan, dimana dugaan dan pelanggaran nyata terhadap Kode Etik dan Perilaku Bisnis dapat dilaporkan.

Beberapa manfaat yang diperoleh dengan adanya penerapan whistleblowing di lingkungan Perseroan adalah:

1. Memiliki wadah untuk penyampaian informasi penting dan kritis bagi Perseroan kepada pihak-pihak yang harus segera menangani informasi tersebut secara aman sesuai dengan prinsip-prinsip dalam whistleblowing
2. Membangun sifat dan kesadaran menolak atau menghindari perbuatan pelanggaran, serta komitmen untuk meningkatkan kesediaan melaporkan terjadinya pelanggaran, yang dibangun atas adanya kepercayaan terhadap sistem pelaporan yang terjamin kerahasiaannya dan efektif
3. Memberikan mekanisme deteksi dini (early warning system) atas kemungkinan terjadinya masalah akibat suatu pelanggaran
4. Memberikan kesempatan untuk menangani masalah pelanggaran secara internal terlebih dahulu, sebelum menjadi masalah pelanggaran yang bersifat publik
5. Mengurangi risiko yang dihadapi organisasi, akibat dari pelanggaran baik dari segi keuangan, operasi, hukum, hubungan dengan pemerintah, keselamatan kerja, dan reputasi
6. Mengurangi biaya dalam menangani akibat dari terjadinya pelanggaran
7. Memperkuat reputasi Perseroan di kalangan pemangku kepentingan, termasuk regulator, dan masyarakat umum
8. Memberikan masukan kepada Perseroan untuk melihat lebih jauh area kritis dan proses kerja yang memiliki kelemahan pengendalian internal, serta untuk merancang tindakan perbaikan yang diperlukan; dan
9. Memotong jalur birokrasi dalam menindaklanjuti adanya dugaan pelanggaran serius yang memerlukan tindakan cepat

In supervising and managing material business risks, the Company had established Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Number SOP 8-02-02/R03 dated November 15, 2021 regarding Risk Management which serves as guidance on how the Company can effectively conduct its process of identifying, analyzing, evaluating, treating, monitoring and reviewing risks.

In addition, the SOP for Risk Management also aims to ensure that management and all employees have the same perception and understanding of the concept of risk management and raise awareness of the importance of risk management.

In general, the picture below describes the risk management process in the Company's environment:

Dalam melakukan pengawasan dan pengelolaan risiko bisnis yang material, Perseroan telah menetapkan Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Nomor SOP 8-02-02/R03 tanggal 15 November 2021 tentang Manajemen Risiko yang menjadi pedoman bagaimana Perseroan dapat secara efektif melakukan proses identifikasi, analisis, evaluasi, perlakuan, pemantauan, dan peninjauan risiko.

Selain itu, SOP Manajemen Risiko tersebut juga bertujuan untuk memastikan bahwa manajemen dan seluruh pegawai memiliki persepsi serta pemahaman yang sama mengenai konsep manajemen risiko dan menumbuhkan kesadaran mengenai pentingnya manajemen risiko.

![img-119.jpeg](img-119.jpeg)

Responsibility for implementation of risk assessment is with each Company working unit (Department/Division). The assessment is documented in a Risk Assessment Form which will serve as the risk register for such working unit. The risk assessment is conducted continuously by the working unit and tested and reviewed by the Internal Audit Division at least annually.

The Company's risk register and profile is reported and reviewed by the Company's Management annually or as significant changes transpire.

## Types of Risk and Management Method

The following are the types of risks used by the Company as a benchmark for conducting risk analysis, including:

### 01. Operational Risk

Risks that arise due to insufficient and/or failure of internal processes, human error, system failure, or external problems affecting business activities such as force majeure, natural disasters, fires and others

### 02. Compliance Risk

Risks caused by the Company not complying with or not implementing statutory regulations and other applicable provisions

### 03. Strategic Risk

Risks arise due to improper strategic determination and implementation, inappropriate decision making, or the Company's lack of responsiveness to external changes

### 04. Reputation Risk

Risks that arise due to negative publicity on operational activities or negative perceptions of the Company

A risk evaluation which is conducted where the probability and the severity level of the identified risk is analyzed and estimated.

The risk evaluation shows the result of what risks should be prioritized for further action.

Follow-up from the results of the risk evaluation will be validated where the results of the validation will be used to establish a control system/process to reduce the likelihood of risk occurring and to reduce the impact of the risk.

It is necessary to have a mitigation/risk treatment for the necessary control plans to be made.

The risk scores which are mandatory to be mitigated are medium and high. Risk mitigation measures include identifying options for dealing with risks, assessing those options, preparing a risk treatment plan, and implementing the risk treatment plan.

Tanggung jawab pelaksanaan penilaian risiko berada pada masing-masing unit kerja Perseroan (Departemen/Divisi). Penilaian tersebut didokumentasikan dalam Risk Assessment Form yang akan berfungsi sebagai daftar risiko untuk unit kerja tersebut. Penilaian risiko dilakukan secara berkelanjutan oleh unit kerja dan diuji serta direview oleh Divisi Internal Audit minimal setiap tahun.

Daftar dan profil risiko Perseroan dilaporkan dan ditinjau oleh Manajemen Perseroan setiap tahun atau jika terjadi perubahan signifikan.

## Jenis Risiko Dan Cara Pengelolaannya

Berikut merupakan jenis-jenis risiko yang digunakan oleh Perseroan sebagai tolak ukur untuk melakukan analisa risiko, antara lain:

### 01. Risiko Operasional

Risiko yang ditimbulkan karena ketidakcukupan dan atau kegagalan proses internal, kesalahan manusia, kegagalan sistem, atau adanya masalah eksternal yang mempengaruhi kegiatan usaha seperti force majeure, bencana alam, kebakaran dan lain-lain

### 02. Risiko Kepatuhan

Risiko yang disebabkan Perseroan tidak mematuhi atau tidak melaksanakan regulasi perundang-undangan dan ketentuan lain yang berlaku

### 03. Risiko Strategis

Risiko timbul karena penetapan dan pelaksanaan strategis yang tidak tepat, pengambilan keputusan yang tidak tepat, atau kurang responsifnya Perseroan terhadap perubahan eksternal

### 04. Risiko Reputasi

Risiko yang timbul karena publikasi negatif terhadap kegiatan operasional atau persepsi negatif terhadap Perseroan

Evaluasi risiko yang dilakukan dimana probabilitas dan tingkat keparahan risiko yang teridentifikasi dianalisa dan diperkirakan.

Evaluasi risiko menunjukkan hasil risiko apa saja yang harus diprioritaskan untuk tindakan lebih lanjut.

Tindak lanjut dari hasil evaluasi risiko akan divalidasi dimana hasil validasi tersebut akan digunakan untuk menetapkan rencana langkah-langkah sistem/proses pengendalian untuk menurunkan kemungkinan terjadinya risiko dan untuk menurunkan dampak dari risiko tersebut.

Perlu adanya suatu mitigasi/perlakuan risiko untuk rencana pengendalian yang perlu dibuat.

Nilai risiko yang wajib dilakukan mitigasi adalah sedang (medium) dan tinggi (high). Langkah mitigasi risiko meliputi pengidentifikasi opsi untuk menangani risiko, menilai opsi tersebut, menyiapkan rencana perlakuan risiko, dan mengimplementasikan rencana perlakuan risiko.

# Public Accountant

Akuntan Publik

Public accountant is an external party supporting the Company in evaluating or auditing the Annual Report in accordance with the Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards. The appointment of a public accountant is expected to help Company provide accountable, independent, and fair information and data to Shareholders, regulator, as well as other stakeholders.

Akuntan publik merupakan organ eksternal yang membantu Perseroan dalam melakukan pemeriksaan atau mengaudit Laporan Keuangan agar sesuai dengan Standar Akuntasi Keuangan yang berlaku di Indonesia. Penunjukan akuntan publik ini diharapkan dapat mendorong Perusahaan untuk memberikan informasi dan data yang akuntabel, independen, dan wajar kepada Pemegang Saham, regulator, serta pemangku kepentingan lainnya.

# External Audit Procedures and Audit Standards
Prosedur Audit Eksternal dan Standar Audit

The audit on the Company's Financial Statement is implemented in accordance with the public accountant's professional standards, covering all audit procedures regarded compatible with the Company's condition. The audit processes are testing, verifying, and evaluating the Financial Statements, as well as assessing the compliance of its contents with the Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards.

The appointment of a public accounting firm ("KAP") is carried out by taking into account the aspects of independence in terms of personnel, processes and audit results so that the Company's Financial Statements meet the principles of transparency and accountability.

As a part of the audit processes, the KAP representatives conducted a question and answer session to obtain the management's statement to be presented in the Financial Statements. Should there be errors found in the Financial Statements, the KAP must convey them to the Management of the Company. The management is also responsible for approving the KAP's audit worksheets.

The Policy relating to Protection of Creditor's Rights
Kebijakan tentang Pemenuhan Hak-Hak Kreditur

This policy related to the fulfillment of creditor's right with the objectives to uphold the fulfillment of creditor's right and preserve the trust given by the creditor to the Company.

The Main Principle of Policy

As a form of the Company's commitment to implementing the principles of Good Corporate Governance, the Company always pays attention to the interests of the parties who help the Company to improve the Company's working capital capabilities as well as a source of funding for medium-term and long-term investment purposes (creditor) in order to continue to gain trust so that the Company's growth prospects in the long term can be maintained.

The Company is committed to establishing mutually beneficial relationships with creditor. We fully carry out the agreements which agreed and committed as long as they do not conflict with the prevailing laws and regulations.

Therefore, the Company has made Policy on the Fulfillment of Creditor's Rights which aims to maintain the fulfillment of creditor's rights and maintain the trust given by a creditor to the Company.

The principles of the policy on fulfillment of creditor's rights carried out by the Company are as follows:

01. The Company considers and measures its ability internally to fulfill creditor's rights before making loans to a creditor. This is conducted to maintain the fulfillment of creditor's rights and maintain creditor's trust in the Company

02. The Company elects a creditor based on the accountable credibility aspect

03. The Company provides any information or documents related to the loan and/or agreement transparently, accurately and timely as agreed in the respective loan agreement with the creditor

Kebijakan ini terkait pemenuhan hak-hak kreditur yang bertujuan untuk menjunjung tinggi pemenuhan hak-hak kreditur dan menjaga kepercayaan yang diberikan kreditur kepada Perseroan.

Prinsip Utama Kebijakan

Sebagai wujud komitmen Perseroan dalam menerapkan prinsip-prinsip Tata Kelola Perseroan yang Baik atau Good Corporate Governance, Perseroan senantiasa memperhatikan kepentingan para pihak yang membantu Perseroan untuk meningkatkan kemampuan modal kerja Perseroan maupun sebagai sumber pendanaan untuk keperluan investasi jangka menengah dan panjang (kreditur) agar dapat terus mendapatkan kepercayaan sehingga prospek pertumbuhan Perseroan dalam jangka panjang dapat terus terjaga.

Perseroan memiliki komitmen dalam menjalin hubungan yang saling bermanfaat dengan kreditur. Kami sepenuhnya melaksanakan perjanjian yang diperjanjikan dan disepakati sepanjang tidak bertentangan dengan peraturan dan perundangan yang berlaku.

Oleh karenanya Perseroan telah menyusun Kebijakan tentang Pemenuhan Hak-Hak Kreditur yang bertujuan untuk menjaga terpenuhinya hak-hak kreditur dan menjaga kepercayaan yang diberikan kreditur terhadap Perseroan.

Prinsip-prinsip kebijakan pemenuhan hak-hak kreditur yang dilakukan oleh Perseroan adalah sebagai berikut:

01. Perseroan mempertimbangkan dan mengukur kemampuannya secara internal untuk memenuhi hak-hak kreditur sebelum melakukan pinjaman kepada kreditur. Hal ini dilakukan untuk menjaga terpenuhinya hak-hak dan menjaga kepercayaan kreditur terhadap Perseroan

02. Perseroan melakukan pemilihan kreditur berdasarkan aspek kredibilitas yang dapat dipertanggungjawabkan

03. Perseroan memberikan informasi atau dokumen-dokumen terkait pinjaman dan/atau kesepakatan secara transparan, akurat dan tepat waktu sebagaimana disepakati dalam masing-masing perjanjian pinjaman dan/atau kesepakatan dengan kreditur

## 2. Henny Puspawati

### Case Status

Status Perkara

PPG has signed Perjanjian Sewa Menyewa (Lease Agreement) with Mrs. Henny for lease of PPG's Warehouse as stated in the Deed No. 1 dated October 1, 2015 ("Lease Agreement"). Pursuant to the Lease Agreement, PPG is required to pay rent for the first five-year lease period in amount IDR 1,775,000,000,-. This obligation has been carried out by PPG, but in its implementation it was discovered that the Warehouse's IMB is not in accordance with its designation, so that the Warehouse could not be used by PPG, and PPG had asked Mrs. Henny to return the rental fee that had been paid by PPG in the amount of IDR 1,175,000,000. This amount has been agreed by PPG and Mrs. Henny as stated in the Perjanjian Pengembalian Uang Sewa dated April 2, 2019 ("Rental Fee Repayment Agreement"). It is stated in the Rental Fee Repayment Agreement that Mrs. Henny will return the rental fee once Mrs. Henny's villa in Bali has been sold. However PPG has not received the rental fee until date since Mrs. Henny's villa in Bali has not been sold.

PPG telah menandatangani Perjanjian Sewa Menyewa (Perjanjian Sewa) dengan Ibu Henny untuk sewa Gudang PPG sebagaimana tercantum dalam Akta No. 1 tanggal 1 Oktober 2015 ("Perjanjian Sewa"). Berdasarkan Perjanjian Sewa, PPG diharuskan membayar sewa untuk masa sewa lima tahun pertama sebesar Rp 1.775.000.000,-. Kewajiban ini sudah dilaksanakan oleh PPG, namun dalam pelaksanaannya ditemukan IMB Gudang yang tidak sesuai dengan peruntukannya, sehingga Gudang tersebut tidak dapat digunakan oleh PPG, dan PPG telah meminta kepada Ibu Henny untuk mengembalikan biaya sewa tersebut yang telah dibayarkan oleh PPG sebesar Rp 1.175.000.000. Jumlah ini telah disepakati oleh PPG dan Ibu Henny sebagaimana tercantum dalam Perjanjian Pengembalian Uang Sewa tanggal 2 April 2019 ("Perjanjian Pembayaran Kembali Biaya Sewa"). Dalam Perjanjian Pelunasan Biaya Sewa disebutkan bahwa Ibu Henny akan mengembalikan biaya sewa setelah vila Ibu Henny di Bali telah terjual. Namun PPG belum menerima biaya sewa hingga saat ini karena vila Ibu Henny di Bali belum terjual.

### Risks Faced by the Company and Their Impacts on the Company

Risiko yang Dihadapi dan Pengaruhnya terhadap Perseroan

PPG will receive a full refund of the invoice amounting to IDR 1,175,000,000 if the villa in Bali has been sold.

PPG akan memperoleh pengembalian tagihan secara penuh yang jumlahnya sebesar Rp 1.175.000.000 jika vila di Bali sudah terjual.

### Follow-up

Tindak Lanjut

Based on Appeal Decision No. 71/PDT/2022/PT YYK from Pengadilan Tinggi Yogyakarta which has been a final and binding decision, Mrs. Henny was ordered inter alia to repayment the rental fee to PPG in amount IDR 1,775,000,000; and stating the security seizure ("sita jaminan") of Mrs. Henny's villa in Bali to be valid and effective. However, PPG has received an objection for the stipulation of security seizure from Mr. Gatot Widjaja Tjipta (ex-husband of Mrs. Henny Puspawati).

Berdasarkan Putusan Banding No. 71/PDT/2022/PT YYK dari Pengadilan Tinggi Yogyakarta yang telah menjadi keputusan final dan mengikat, Ibu Henny diperintahkan antara lain untuk membayar kembali biaya sewa ke PPG sebesar Rp 1.775.000.000,-; dan menyatakan jaminan sita (sita jaminan) vila Ibu Henny di Bali sah dan efektif. Namun PPG telah menerima keberatan atas penetapan sita jaminan dari Bapak Gatot Widjaja Tjipta (mantan suami Ibu Henny Puspawati).

# Fulfillment of Recommendation of SEOJK No.32/SEOJK.04/2015

Pemenuhan Rekomendasi SEOJK No.32/SEOJK.04/2015

The Company always pays attention to and implements GCG principles in accordance with the Guidelines for Public Company Governance which has been regulated in the Circular Letter of the Financial Services Authority No.32/SEOJK.04/2015.

The implementation of these guidelines is described as follows, in which in principle the Company will always implement the recommendations and improve its quality from time to time:

Principles:
Improving the Value of General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS) Implementation

Perseroan senantiasa memperhatikan dan menerapkan prinsip-prinsip GCG sesuai dengan Pedoman Tata Kelola Perusahaan Terbuka yang telah diatur dalam Surat Edaran Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No.32/SEOJK.04/2015.

Penerapan pedoman tersebut diuraikan sebagai berikut, yang mana pada prinsipnya Perseroan akan senantiasa menerapkan rekomendasi dan meningkatkan kualitasnya dari waktu ke waktu:

# Explanation of the Sustainability Strategy

Penjelasan Strategi Bekerlanjutan

## Sustainability Strategy
Strategi Keberlanjutan

Recognising that our world binds us together in a dynamic, complex network of relationships. We know the health of people (including our workforce and society at large), the planet and our business are interconnected. The scale and severity of the issues we face today require us to assess all options simultaneously. We look for opportunities that offer synergies and address systemic issues.

Acknowledging there are no quick fixes; anticipating and designing out unintended impacts; observing how impacts change over time; building resilience. We differentiate between addressing our negative environmental impacts and creating the conditions for deep, lasting sustainability.

We will conduct a materiality analysis through the help of Pricewaterhouse Coopers, a reputable and independent third party who have been assisting companies in their ESG journey. The objective was to identify the sustainability issues that form PT SGH and its subsidiaries' (the Group) non-financial strategic approach.

The list of materiality topics used for the assessment is based on the sector guidelines from the Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB) while the assessment questionnaire questions are aligned with the guidance of the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI). This exercise also aligns the Group to the term of "Dual Materiality" for the disclosure of non-financial information.

The material issues identified would fall into two main pillars which are:

a. The Company's impact on society and the environment
b. The impact of society and the environment to the Group

We are currently using the metrics set by regulators as our baseline. Once we finally determine our material areas, we would be able to put more focus on the areas which is consistent with key objectives in our sustainability journey.

Menyadari bahwa dunia kita mengikat kita bersama dalam jaringan hubungan yang dinamis dan kompleks. Kita tahu kesehatan orang (termasuk tenaga kerja kita dan masyarakat pada umumnya), dunia dan bisnis kita saling berhubungan. Skala dan keparahan masalah yang kita hadapi saat ini mengharuskan kita untuk menilai semua opsi secara bersamaan. Kami mencari peluang yang menawarkan sinergi dan mengatasi masalah sistemik.

Mengakui tidak ada perbaikan cepat; mengantisipasi dan merancang dampak yang tidak diinginkan; mengamati bagaimana dampak berubah dari waktu ke waktu; membangun ketahanan. Kami membedakan antara mengatasi dampak lingkungan negatif kami dan menciptakan kondisi untuk keberlanjutan yang dalam dan langgeng.

Kami akan melakukan analisis materialitas melalui bantuan Pricewaterhouse Coopers, pihak ketiga yang bereputasi baik dan independen yang telah membantu perusahaan dalam perjalanan ESG mereka. Tujuannya adalah untuk mengidentifikasi isu-isu keberlanjutan yang membentuk pendekatan strategis non-keuangan PT SGH dan anak perusahaannya (Grup).

Daftar topik materialitas yang digunakan untuk penilaian didasarkan pada panduan sektor dari Dewan Standar Akuntansi Keberlanjutan (SASB) sedangkan pertanyaan kuesioner penilaian diselaraskan dengan panduan Global Reporting Initiative (GRI). Latihan ini juga menyelaraskan Grup dengan istilah "Dual Materiality" untuk pengungkapan informasi non-keuangan.

Isu-isu material yang teridentifikasi terbagi menjadi dua pilar utama yaitu:

a. Dampak Perusahaan terhadap masyarakat dan lingkungan
b. Dampak masyarakat dan lingkungan terhadap Grup

Kami saat ini menggunakan metrik yang ditetapkan oleh regulator sebagai dasar kami. Begitu kami akhirnya menentukan area material kami, kami akan dapat lebih fokus pada area yang konsisten dengan tujuan utama dalam perjalanan keberlanjutan kami.

# Overview of Sustainability Aspects

Gambaran Umum Aspek Keberlanjutan

## Environment Friendly Innovation

We implement some green technology in carrying out our business processes. The application of green technology applied includes maximizing the use of extracted waste to become compost which is used in the curcuma garden at the SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) as organic fertilizer, SCEHR is certified as organic practitioner by the Indonesian Organic Farming Certification.

We also started shifting the use of organic solvents to water-based solvents for product coating. Further, we reduced the aluminium foil content of some of our packaging materials, this did not significantly impact the quality of the packaging.

## Partnership with Local Stakeholders

SOHO Global Health is committed to contributing to the socio-economic aspects of farmers and communities. We do this through the development of science and technology with academia through various extraction, pre-clinical (toxicity and efficacy) research and clinical trials and actively provide a resource person support to the Kampus Merdeka learning program, a program by the Ministry of Education and Culture which gives Universities the ability to provide courses and activities that would suit the interests of students outside of the standard curriculum. Several academics and institutions that have become research partners and Kampus Merdeka programs include the Faculty of Pharmacy and the Department of Chemical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, Gadjah Mada University, Yogyakarta, Faculty of Pharmacy, University of Indonesia, Depok, School of Pharmacy, Bandung Institute of Technology, Bogor Agricultural University, Udayana University Faculty of Medicine, as well as the National Research and Innovation Agency (BRIN). Through these various researches, several innovative products have been produced as well as scientific publications in both national and international journals.

We also collaborate with communities around the SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR), such as the Dahlia Women Farmers Group. We are also committed to increasing farmers' income, including through the implementation of Smart Farming 4.0 which was initiated in 2020 and has been applied to all planted areas in the 2021 and 2022 planting year. We also encourage farmers to apply intercropping with sweet corn plants to help the farmers' have more income from crops. We conducted a research related to the cultivation of intercropping during the curcuma cultivation process, where the method of intercropping with sweet corn did not affect the quality of the curcuma produced. In fact intercropping was able to provide a positive impact for farmers, repeated land cultivation enriches the soil so that it gives a positive impact on curcuma cultivation.

## Inovasi Ramah Lingkungan

Kami menerapkan beberapa teknologi hijau dalam menjalankan proses bisnis kami. Penerapan teknologi hijau yang diterapkan antara lain memaksimalkan pemanfaatan limbah hasil ekstraksi menjadi kompos yang digunakan di kebun temulawak di SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) sebagai pupuk organik, SCEHR bersertifikat praktisi organik oleh Sertifikasi Pertanian Organik Indonesia.

Kami juga mulai mengalihkan penggunaan pelarut organik ke pelarut berbasis air untuk pelapisan produk. Selanjutnya, kami mengurangi kandungan aluminium foil dari beberapa bahan kemasan kami, hal ini tidak berdampak signifikan terhadap kualitas kemasan.

## Kemitraan dengan Pemangku Kepentingan Lokal

SOHO Global Health berkomitmen untuk berkontribusi pada aspek sosial ekonomi petani dan masyarakat serta terlibat dalam pengembangan ilmu pengetahuan dan teknologi bersama akademisi melalui berbagai riset ekstraksi, pre klinik (toksisitas dan efikasi) serta uji klinik dan aktif menjadi narasumber pada program pembelajaran Kampus Merdeka, sebuah program oleh Kementerian Pendidikan dan Kebudayaan yang memberikan hak kepada Universitas untuk menyediakan kursus dan kegiatan yang sesuai dengan minat siswa di luar standar kurikulum. Beberapa akademisi dan institusi yang menjadi mitra riset dan program Kampus Merdeka antara lain Fakultas Farmasi dan Departemen Teknik Kimia Fakultas Teknik Universitas Gadjah Mada Yogyakarta, Fakultas Farmasi Universitas Indonesia Depok, Sekolah Farmasi Institut Teknologi Bandung, Institut Pertanian Bogor, Fakultas Kedokteran Universitas Udayana, serta Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional (BRIN). Melalui berbagai riset tersebut telah dihasilkan beberapa produk inovatif serta publikasi ilmiah baik pada jurnal nasional maupun internasional.

Kami juga bekerja sama dengan masyarakat sekitar SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) dalam hal ini dengan Kelompok Wanita Tani Dahlia. Kami juga berkomitmen untuk meningkatkan pendapatan petani, salah satunya dengan implementasi Smart Farming 4.0 yang telah dirintis pada tahun 2020 dan telah diterapkan di seluruh area tanam pada tahun tanam 2021 dan 2022. Kami juga mendorong petani untuk menerapkan tumpang sari dengan tanaman jagung manis untuk membantu petani mendapatkan lebih banyak pendapatan dari tanaman. Kami melakukan penelitian terkait budi daya tumpang sari selama proses budi daya temulawak, dimana metode tumpang sari dengan jagung manis tidak mempengaruhi kualitas temulawak yang dihasilkan. Bahkan tumpang sari tidak hanya mampu memberikan dampak positif bagi petani, penggarapan lahan secara berulang mampu menyuburkan tanah sehingga juga dapat memberikan dampak positif bagi budidaya temulawak.

In 2022, SOHO Global Health will again begin to develop the Seed to Patient concept for products made from Echinacea purpurea (L.) Moench. Although Echinacea is natively an herb from Europe with subtropical to temperate climates, the extensive use of Echinacea outside European countries including Indonesia, makes Echinacea one of the herbs that has been naturalized to become an endogenous Indonesian herb. By applying the concept of Academic, Business, Government and Community (ABGC) collaboration, we have collaborated with the Spice and Medicinal Plants Research Institute (Balittro) to obtain superior Echinacea seeds in Indonesia and also with the GAPOKTAN Dahlia farming community for their cultivation. As such, SOHO has succeeded in carrying out Cultivation of Echinacea purpurea on SCEHR land which is estimated to be carried out 2-3 times each growing season. Each growing season, the amount of Echinacea simplicia produced ranges from 0.25-0.5 kg per m². The Echinacea simplicia produced by SCEHR also has superior quality with active biomarker levels that have met or even exceeded the Echinacea simplicia quality standards set by the European Medicines Agency (EMA).

Further collaboration with academics in testing the effectiveness of extracts as antioxidants, tests are carried out by determining the IC₅₀ value of each extract. IC₅₀ itself is defined as the concentration of antioxidant compounds needed to reduce radical activity by 50%, where a smaller value indicates higher activity. The test results showed that Echinacea purpurea extract from SCEHR had the best antioxidant effect compared to other Echinacea extract samples.

In producing its products, SIP is committed to using materials that are locally sourced. This is evidenced by the TKDN (Total Domestic Component) certification issued by the Ministry of Industry. TKDN is the percentage value of domestic materials and/or services that comprise a product. TKDN certificate is the proof prioritizing the use of domestic products for the production or provision of goods or services. Dalam memproduksi produk-produknya, SIP berkomitmen untuk menggunakan bahan-bahan yang berasal dari dalam negeri. Hal ini dibuktikan dengan sertifikasi TKDN (Total Komponen Dalam Negeri) yang dikeluarkan oleh Kementerian Perindustrian. TKDN adalah persentase nilai komponen produksi yang dibuat di Indonesia pada suatu produk barang dan jasa atau gabungan barang dan jasa dalam negeri. Sertifikat TKDN dapat digunakan sebagai bukti penggunaan produk dalam negeri untuk memproduksi dan memberikan barang atau jasa. Saat ini PT Soho telah memiliki sertifikat TKDN untuk 66 produk, dan proses sertifikasi TKDN masih terus berlangsung untuk produk-produk lainnya.
