# GHG (Greenhouse Gas) Emission Control in Response to Climate Change

Climate change and global warming are problems that must be addressed by everyone. To that end, Soho Global Health contributes to curbing the extreme rate of climate change. This initiative supports the Government of Indonesia's commitment after they ratified the Paris Agreement. Climate change, including greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions poses a potential risk of reducing the availability of herbal raw materials for our products. To maintain the sustainability of existing herbal raw materials from local suppliers, we continue to provide guidance to the curcuma farmers regarding climate change and sustainable ecosystem management.

We ensure that the management of all direct emissions from boiler operations, machine production and standby generators always comply with regulatory requirements. This is achieved by conducting routine tool maintenance, regular emission levels testing, and reporting to the Environment Agency every six months. Our initiatives to reduce GHG emissions also includes planning of initiative for the renewable energy mix to make it cleaner, more sustainable, and free from carbon emissions. Tree planting and landscape greening in the factory areas also contributes to absorbing  $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$  from the surrounding environment. We have engaged Schneider Electric to assist us in our initiative for Net Zero Emission by developing our Science Based Targets and developing a Decarbonization Roadmap.

# Pengendalian Emisi GRK (Gas Rumah Kaca) sebagai Tanggapan atas Perubahan Iklim

Perubahan iklim dan pemanasan global merupakan masalah yang harus ditanggulangi oleh seluruh elemen masyarakat. Untuk itu, Soho Global Health juga turut berkontribusi dalam menekan laju perubahan iklim yang ekstrim. Inisiatif ini mendukung komitmen Pemerintah Indonesia setelah meratifikasi Paris Agreement. Perubahan iklim, termasuk emisi Gas Rumah Kaca (GRK) berpotensi menurunkan ketersediaan bahan baku herbal untuk produk kami. Untuk menjaga keberlanjutan bahan baku herbal yang ada dari pemasok lokal, kami terus melakukan pembinaan kepada para petani temulawak mengenai perubahan iklim dan pengelolaan ekosistem yang berkelanjutan.

Kami memastikan bahwa pengelolaan semua emisi langsung dari operasi boiler, mesin produksi, dan generator siaga selalu memenuhi peraturan saat ini. Hal ini dicapai dengan mempertahankan penggunaan alat yang tepat, pengujian tingkat emisi secara teratur, dan pelaporan ke Badan Lingkungan Hidup setiap enam bulan sekali. Inisiatif kami untuk mengurangi emisi GRK juga mencakup perencanaan inisiatif pengunaan energi terbarukan agar lebih bersih, lebih berkelanjutan, dan bebas dari emisi karbon. Penanaman pohon dan penghijauan lanskap di area pabrik juga berkontribusi dalam menyerap  $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$  dari lingkungan sekitar. Kami telah melibatkan Schneider Electric untuk membantu kami dalam inisiatif Net Zero Emission dengan mengembangkan Target Berbasis Sains dan mengembangkan Peta Jalan Dekarbonisasi.

# Efficiency Strategies

01. Electricity - Optimizing and improving the production process thus, minimizing overtime
02. Water - Monitoring usage and leaks in pipelines and storage tank
03. Gas - Efficiently using the steam boilers

Some of the initiatives that have been performed:

01. Replacement of chiller pipe insulation to minimize loss of cooling energy generated from the chiller generator. By replacing the chiller insulation, we can minimize cooling leaks in the chiller water distribution line thereby reducing energy consumption
02. Chiller unit replacement and scaling of production engine cooling lines to maximize engine work processes. With chiller unit replacement and scaling of the cooling line, the production process becomes faster, thereby reducing energy usage
03. Replace lamps with LED type as this type is more energy efficient
04. Replacement of underground water tank from the old building by a water tower, so that leaks will be easily spotted. This reduces loss of water due to leakage of underground reservoir
05. Replacement of city water pipes which were previously made of metal and had the potential to leak because the pipes are old and corroded, replaced with HDPE to minimize leaks
06. Carry out routine maintenance on boiler generators and steam distribution lines so that the use of gas fuel becomes efficient

# Waste Management

Our waste is managed based on the type and material content, which is comprised of solid and liquid waste, and hazardous and toxic (B3) and non-B3 materials. Our waste management is carried in collaboration with licensed third parties.

Liquid waste is managed through the Waste Water Management Installation (IPAL). We ensure that run-off water meets Government established quality standards before being released into bodies of water, or channelled for further processing by industrial estate managers. Waste water quality monitoring is carried out internally and externally and involves an environmental laboratory accredited by the National Accreditation Committee (NAC) and registered with the Ministry of Environment and Forestry (MoEF). Their inspection results are routinely reported to the City/District Environmental Agency and the Provincial Environmental Management Agency and the MoEF.

The management of non-B3 solid waste follows the 3R principle; reduce, reuse, and recycle. The B3 waste management is entrusted to third parties authorized by the MoEF in accordance with the applicable regulations. Business units participating in the PROPER Program use an electronic-based B3 waste reporting system making the traceability process easier and more accurate.

# Strategi Efisiensi

01. Listrik - Mengoptimalkan dan memperbaiki proses produksi sehingga, meminimalkan lembur
02. Air - Pemantauan penggunaan dan kebocoran pada pipa dan tangki penyimpanan
03. Gas - Menggunakan ketel uap secara efisien

Beberapa inisiatif yang telah dilakukan:

01. Penggantian isolasi pipa pendingin untuk meminimalkan kehilangan energi pendinginan yang dihasilkan dari generator pendingin. Dengan mengganti isolasi pendingin, kita dapat meminimalkan kebocoran pendinginan di jalur distribusi air pendingin sehingga mengurangi konsumsi energi
02. Penggantian unit pendingin dan pembersihan kerak jalur pendinginan mesin produksi untuk memaksimalkan proses kerja mesin. Dengan penggantian unit pendingin dan pembersihan kerak jalur pendingin, proses produksi menjadi lebih cepat, sehingga mengurangi penggunaan energi
03. Mengganti lampu dengan tipe LED karena tipe ini lebih hemat energi
04. Penggantian bak penampung air bawah tanah dari bangunan lama dengan toren air, sehingga kebocoran akan mudah terlihat. Hal ini mengurangi kehilangan air karena kebocoran dari bak penampung bawah tanah
05. Penggantian pipa air PAM yang tadinya berbahan logam dan potensi bocor karena pipa sudah termakan usia serta terjadi korosi, digantikan dengan pipa HDPE untuk meminimalisir kebocoran.
06. Melakukan perawatan rutin pada generator boiler dan jalur distribusi steam sehingga penggunaan bahan bakar gas menjadi efisien.

# Penanganan Limbah

Limbah kami dikelola berdasarkan jenis dan kandungan bahannya, meliputi limbah padat dan cair, serta bahan berbahaya dan beracun (B3) dan non-B3. Pengelolaan limbah kami dilakukan secara mandiri, atau bekerja sama dengan pihak ketiga yang memiliki izin.

Limbah cair dikelola melalui Instalasi Pengolahan Air Limbah (IPAL). Kami memastikan bahwa air limpasan memenuhi kualitas yang ditetapkan. Pemerintah baku sebelum dibuang ke badan air, atau dialirkan untuk diproses lebih lanjut oleh pengelola kawasan industri. Pemantauan kualitas air limbah dilakukan secara internal dan eksternal dan melibatkan laboratorium lingkungan yang terakreditasi oleh Komite Akreditasi Nasional (KPA) dan terdaftar di Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup dan Kehutanan (KLHK). Hasil pengawasan mereka secara rutin dilaporkan ke Kota/Kabupaten Badan Lingkungan Hidup dan Badan Pengelolaan Lingkungan Hidup Provinsi dan KLHK.

Pengelolaan limbah padat non-B3 mengikuti prinsip 3R; mengurangi, menggunakan kembali, dan mendaur ulang. Pengelolaan limbah B3 dipercayakan kepada pihak ketiga yang diberi wewenang oleh KLHK sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku. Unit bisnis yang berpartisipasi dalam Program PROPER menggunakan sistem pelaporan limbah B3 berbasis elektronik, sehingga proses penelusuran lebih mudah dan lebih akurat.

# Efforts to Reduce Waste

Hazardous waste management is conducted through a Waste Management Procedure (procedure for handling hazardous and non-hazardous waste, starting from the handover of waste generators, storage of waste, handover to third parties, and emergency handling). All operational activities within the Hazardous Waste Temporary Storage are monitored through the Waste Balance Sheet Reports and Waste Record. This is to ensure that the amount of incoming hazardous waste matches the amount of hazardous waste handed over to a waste management agency that has a permit from the Ministry of Environment and Forestry. The Waste Balance is an integral part of mandatory reporting to the Ministry as part of environmental compliance. The initial processing of the waste generated and the optimization of the production process also contributes to reducing hazardous waste produced (pre-treatment, crushing, washing, compressing and as a mixture for animal food).

The research and development department has also started to carry out initiatives that can support environmentally friendly products. Such as reducing the thickness of aluminium foil for some products so as to reduce waste. Including in terms of raw materials used, changes have also been made from organic solvents to water-based ingredients. For all new products, water-based ingredients are used for tablet coatings.

Changing bottle and cap design with better heat resistance to prevent dented bottle from heat shock after hot filling and instant cooling process. This initiative also reduce bottle and cap rejection.

Production Department improved the process of transferring honey from jerry can into mixing tank to accelerate the process and minimize the leftover of raw material on container.

Improvement effort was also done in tableting process of effervescent tablet to minimize reject and increase product yield.

Other department, such as Quality Control and Quality Assurance are also contributing to support waste reduction. Simplification of analysis process to speed up analysis time and reduce the use of reagent (less waste) and energy usage.

# Upaya Mengurangi Limbah

Pengelolaan limbah B3 dilakukan melalui Prosedur Pengelolaan Limbah (Prosedur penanganan limbah B3, mulai dari serah terima penghasil limbah, penyimpanan limbah, serah terima ke pihak ketiga, dan penanganan darurat). Seluruh kegiatan operasional di Tempat Penimbunan Sementara Limbah B3 dipantau melalui Laporan Neraca Limbah dan Pencatatan Limbah. Hal ini untuk memastikan jumlah limbah B3 yang masuk sesuai dengan jumlah limbah B3 yang dikeluarkan ke badan pengelola limbah yang memiliki izin dari Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup dan Kehutanan. Neraca Limbah merupakan bagian integral dari pelaporan wajib kepada Kementerian sebagai bagian dari kepatuhan lingkungan. Pengolahan awal limbah yang dihasilkan dan optimalisasi proses produksi juga berkontribusi dalam pengurangan limbah B3 yang dihasilkan (pre-treatment, crushing, washing, compressing, dan sebagai campuran makanan hewani).

Dari departemen penelitian dan pengembangan juga sudah mulai melakukan inisiatif yang bisa mendukung dari produk ramah lingkungan. Seperti melakukan pengurangan ketebalan aluminium foil untuk beberapa produk sehingga mengurangi dari sisi limbahnya. Termasuk dari sisi bahan mentah juga sudah mulai melakukan perubahan dari pelarut ber bahan organik ke bahan dasar air. Untuk semua produk baru sudah menggunakan bahan dasar air untuk pelapis tablet.

Mengubah desain botol dan tutup dengan ketahanan panas yang lebih baik untuk mencegah botol penyok dari sengatan panas setelah pengisian panas dan proses pendinginan instan. Inisiatif ini juga mengurangi jumlah limbah botol dan tutup botol yang dihasilkan.

Departemen Produksi melakukan perbaikan pada proses transfer madu dari jerigen ke tangki mixing untuk mempercepat proses dan untuk meminimalkan sisa bahan baku di wadah.

Upaya perbaikan juga dilakukan pada proses pencatatan tablet effervescent sehingga bisa mengurangi produk akhir dan meningkatkan rendemen produk.

Departemen lain, seperti Quality Control dan Quality Assurance juga memiliki kontribusi untuk mendukung pengurangan limbah. Penyederhanaan proses analisis juga dapat mempercepat waktu analisis dan mengurangi penggunaan reagen (lebih sedikit limbah) dan penggunaan energi.

Other improvement includes reducing the use of paper. Change control process used to be longer in terms of time for transferring printed document between each stakeholder/approver. Development of Integrated Change Control System (ICCS) is successful to cut the time and reduce paper usage.

Perbaikan lainnya juga mengurangi penggunaan kertas. Proses kontrol perubahan dulunya lebih lama dalam hal waktu untuk mentransfer dokumen tercetak antara masing-masing pemangku kepentingan/penyetuju. Pengembangan Integrated Change Control System (ICCS) berhasil memangkas waktu dan mengurangi penggunaan kertas.

## Care for the earth program: SOHO Global Health in collaboration with Eco Camp encourages talented children to be friends with nature and love the earth

Program merawat bumi: SOHO Global Health berkolaborasi dengan Eco Camp ajak anak hebat berkawan dengan alam untuk sayangi bumi

Every mother certainly hopes that her child grows up to be a great person. For a mother, it is a simple happiness to see her child grow and develop optimally according to their abilities and age.

Therefore, mothers need to know what the characteristics of an optimal growing child are, ranging from physical growth, brain development, to their psychological development. A great and healthy child experiences a height increase that corresponds to their age. The child also experiences good brain development, and their psychological well-being is maintained so that they can adapt and learn quickly, be active and explorative, and have a high sense of curiosity. Healthy and optimal-growing children are also supported by a clean, safe, and comfortable environment.

Such environmental conditions can be created through caring for the earth, such as planting and taking care of trees, disposing of waste properly, and many others. This is important to do considering that the earth provides water, land, and air to support human life, as well as in response to the kindness of the earth. It is just as important to instil a sense of responsibility and obligation in children from an early age to care for and love the earth.

Setiap ibu pasti mengharapkan buah hatinya tumbuh menjadi anak hebat. Bagi ibu adalah kebahagiaan sederhana melihat buah hati tumbuh dan berkembang optimal sesuai dengan kemampuan dan usianya.

Untuk itu Ibu perlu mengetahui apa saja ciri-ciri anak yang tumbuh hebat mulai dari pertumbuhan fisik, perkembangan otak, hingga psikologisnya. Anak hebat dan sehat mengalami pertambahan tinggi badan sesuai dengan usianya. Anak juga mengalami perkembangan otak yang baik serta psikologisnya terjaga sehingga ia bisa beradaptasi dan belajar dengan cepat, aktif dan suka bereksplorasi, serta memiliki rasa keingintahuan yang tinggi. Anak yang tumbuh sehat dan menjadi hebat juga didukung dengan kondisi lingkungan yang bersih, aman, dan nyaman.

Kondisi lingkungan tersebut dapat diciptakan melalui kegiatan merawat bumi, seperti menanam serta merawat pohon, membuang sampah pada tempatnya dan lain-lain. Hal ini penting dilakukan mengingat bumi yang menyediakan air, tanah, udara untuk mendukung kehidupan manusia, serta sebagai balasan atas kebaikan bumi. Sama pentingnya dengan menanamkan rasa tanggung jawab dan kewajiban pada diri anak-anak sejak dini, untuk merawat serta menyayangi bumi.

Therefore, SOHO Global Health encourages Indonesian children to care for and love the earth together with Eco Camp, a foundation under the "Yayasan Sahabat Lingkungan Hidup". The tangible manifestation of the collaboration between SOHO Global Health and Eco Camp is through the "Berkawan dengan Alam" ("BDA") program. This program is a real action in bringing young children and their mothers to connect with nature through various educational and fun activities.

The BDA program in 2022 was held from July to December 2022 in 6 cities, including Bandung, Tasik & Garut, Semarang, Solo, Tulungagung, and Malang. The BDA program in 2022 was attended by a total of 700 schools with more than 53,000 participants consisting of children and mothers, in 56 locations.

The core of the BDA program includes an ecological education activity called "Adventure Collecting Points at Each Station." There are 5 stations, namely station 1 for creativity with pots, station 2 for colouring, station 3 for farm frenzy, station 4 for gardening, and station 5 for waste collection. The activities at each station teach children to care for and love the earth, and also beneficial for children's growth and development, such as enhancing creativity and helping cognitive and psychological development.

Oleh karena itu, SOHO Global Health mengajak anak-anak Indonesia untuk merawat dan menyayangi bumi bersama Eco Camp yang bernaung di bawah Yayasan Sahabat Lingkungan Hidup. Eco Camp mengembangkan aktivitas edukasi, konservasi, riset, dan pengembangan komunitas serta berbagai aktivitas kreatif lainnya yang berbasis lingkungan. Soho Global Health telah mendukung Yayasan Sahabat Lingkungan Hidup sejak tahun 2014 dan akan berkesinambungan mendukung tiap tahun.

Wujud nyata kolaborasi SOHO Global Health dan Eco Camp adalah melalui program Berkawan dengan Alam (BDA). Program ini merupakan aksi nyata dalam mengajak anak usia dini beserta ibunya untuk terhubung dengan alam melalui berbagai aktivitas edukatif dan menyenangkan.

Program BDA di tahun 2022 dilaksanakan di sepanjang bulan Juli – Desember 2022 di 6 kota, terdiri dari Bandung, Tasik & Garut, Semarang, Solo, Tulungagung, dan Malang. Program ini diikuti oleh total 700 sekolah dengan lebih dari 53.000 peserta yang terdiri dari anak dan ibu, di 56 titik lokasi.

Inti acara program BDA ini termasuk kegiatan edukasi ekologi "Petualangan Mengumpulkan poin di setiap pos". Terdapat 5 pos, yaitu pos 1 kreativitas pot, pos 2 mewarnai, pos 3 farm frenzy, pos 4 berkebun, dan pos 5 pengumpulan sampah. Kegiatan di setiap pos ini mengajarkan anak untuk merawat dan menyayangi bumi, serta bermanfaat untuk tumbuh kembang anak, seperti meningkatkan kreativitas dan membantu perkembangan kognitif serta psikologis anak.

# Hope for Sumba Hope for Indonesia program: SOHO Global Health in collaboration with English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba together fights for literacy

Hope for Sumba Hope for Indonesia program: SOHO Global Health berkolaborasi dengan English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba berjuang bersama untuk literasi

SGH supports English learning activities for school-age children in Sumba organized by the English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba community in Lamboya village, Laboya Bawa, West Sumba through the Share the Books program: Hope for Sumba Hope for Indonesia.

In the midst of the challenging conditions in West Sumba, where schools are poorly equipped and access to books is limited, the donations and acts of kindness from Soho Global Health (SGH) colleagues mean a great deal to the local children. Reading books, stationery, and monetary donations are all greatly appreciated. Books serve as a window to the world, helping children at EGK Sumba learn about the world and build their dreams.

The children and youth of Sumba are the future generations of the island, particularly in the tourism sector, which relies heavily on foreign visitors. Therefore, it is crucial to provide English language learning resources to the youth in Sumbanese villages. In 2015, a humanitarian and literacy activist named Roswita Asti Kulla initiated English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba, which has since reached over 1,000 Sumbanese children. However, there is still a long way to go to achieve the foundation's mission of making education accessible on Sumba Island.

"There's nothing more contagious than the laughter of young children", and seeing their innocent smiles reminds us of our responsibility to fight for literacy. Every child, regardless of their economic situation, deserves an equal opportunity to access education and pursue their dreams. It is our duty to provide them with the tools and resources they need to succeed.

SGH mendukung kegiatan belajar bahasa Inggris bagi anak-anak usia sekolah di Sumba yang diselenggarakan oleh komunitas English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba di desa Lamboya, Laboya Bawa, Sumba Barat melalui program Share the Books: Hope for Sumba Hope for Indonesia.

Di tengah kondisi Sumba Barat yang sulit dijangkau, kondisi sekolah yang kurang memadai dan keterbatasan terhadap akses buku bacaan, donasi dan kepedulian rekan-rekan Soho Global Health (SGH) yang berbagi buku bacaan, alat tulis dan donasi dana sungguh sangat berarti bagi mereka. Sungguh buku adalah jendela dunia, melalui buku, anak-anak di EGK Sumba mulai mengenal dunia, dan memberikan diri membangun impian.

Anak-anak dan pemuda Sumba, menjadi generasi masa depan Sumba, khususnya di sektor pariwisata yang mengandalkan wisatawan manca negara. Ada kebutuhan mendasar untuk menyediakan sumber daya belajar bahasa Inggris bagi para pemuda desa di Sumba. Sejak tahun 2015, English Goes to Kampung (EGK) Sumba diinisiasi oleh seorang penggerak kemanusiaan dan penggiat literasi, Roswita Asti Kulla, memulai dari kelas kecil di pesisir pantai. Hari ini, Yayasan ini telah menjangkau lebih dari 1.000 anak Sumba. Namun perjuangan masih panjang untuk mewujudkan misi komunitas ini: membuat pendidikan dapat diakses secara menyeluruh di Pulau Sumba.

"There's nothing more contagious than the laughter of young children", dan untuk melihat senyum polos mereka tetap mereka, adalah tanggungjawab kita untuk memastikan mereka "melek" literasi. Bagaimanapun keadaan ekonomi mereka saat ini, setiap anak harus punya kesempatan yang sama atas akses pendidikan dan membangun harapan untuk mewujudkan impian mereka.

# COVID-19 Vaccination Program

As a company in pharmaceutical and distribution, SOHO Global Health (SGH) Group supported the Indonesian Government efforts to accelerate COVID-19 vaccination in order to achieve herd immunity, one of which was by participating in the Mutual Cooperation Vaccination (Vaksinasi Gotong Royong/VGR) program initiated by the Indonesian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KADIN).

The VGR was held in collaboration of SGH with KADIN, Biofarma, and Kimia Farma as one of the primary care appointed by the government as the organizer of the COVID-19 vaccination, using sinopharm vaccine. The primary vaccines (first and second dosages) which has been administered since June 28, 2021 for SGH employees and their spouses who are located in Greater Jakarta and Bandung.

The vaccinations was carried out on-site at the SGH office and also walk-in to the nearest Kimia Farma Clinic from the office location. The VGR funding was fully covered by the Company.

# Pengembangan Komunitas

Kami memberikan dukungan yang diperlukan untuk meningkatkan produktivitas dan kualitas hasil panen, serta memastikan akses pasar jangka panjang dari hasil panen temulawak melalui koordinasi dengan Gapoktan Dahlia Sukabumi. # Program Vaksinasi COVID-19

Sebagai perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang farmasi dan distribusinya, SOHO Global Health (SGH) Group mendukung upaya Pemerintah Republik Indonesia dalam percepatan vaksinasi COVID-19 guna mencapai kekebalan kelompok, dimana salah satunya dengan berpartisipasi dalam program Vaksinasi Gotong Royong (VGR) yang diinisiasi oleh Kamar Dagang dan Industri (KADIN) Indonesia.

# Activities with Labor Union
Aktivitas dengan Serikat Pekerja

Collective Labor Agreement Negotiation for the period 2022 to 2024

PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi (PT SIP) as an entity of SGH respects the right of employees to assemble and associate. This is proved by the establishment of the Reformed Pharmacy and Health Labor Union PT SIP's work unit (referred to as the Labor Union) since August 8, 2001 whose existence was legalized by the Ministry of Manpower in accordance with the approval letter number 147/IV/P/VIII/2001.

PT Soho Industri Pharmasi (SIP) has had a Collective Labor Agreement (CLA) since 1983 as a result of negotiations between PT SIP and the Labor Union, which biennially reviewed to ensure the contents are always up to date and relevant to the current situation.

The current CLA is for the period of 2022 to 2024, which was mutually agreed upon by the Company and the Labor Union after going through lengthy negotiations, and finally ratified by the Ministry of Manpower of the Republic of Indonesia on August 16, 2022.

Perundingan Perjanjian Kerja Bersama Periode Tahun 2022 sampai dengan 2024

PT SOHO Industri Pharmasi (PT SIP) sebagai salah satu entitas dari SGH menghormati hak karyawan untuk berkumpul dan berserikat. Hal tersebut dibuktikan dengan berdirinya Serikat Pekerja Farmasi dan Kesehatan Reformasi unit kerja PT SIP (disebut sebagai Serikat Pekerja) sejak tanggal 8 Agustus 2001 yang keberadaannya disahkan oleh Departemen Tenaga Kerja sesuai surat pengesahan nomor 147/IV/P/VIII/2001.

PT Soho Industri Pharmasi (SIP) telah memiliki Perjanjian Kerja Bersama (PKB) sejak tahun 1983 sebagai hasil perundingan antara PT SIP dengan Serikat Pekerja, dan ditinjau secara berkala yakni setiap periode 2 tahun untuk memastikan isi perjanjian selalu diperbarui dan relevan dengan situasi terkini.

PKB yang berlaku saat ini merupakan PKB periode tahun 2022 sampai dengan 2024 yang telah disepakati bersama oleh Perusahaan dan Serikat Pekerja setelah melalui perundingan yang cukup panjang, dan akhirnya disahkan oleh Kementerian Tenaga Kerja Republik Indonesia pada tanggal 16 Agustus 2022.

The CLA negotiations this time consisted of 7 representatives from the Company and 15 representatives from the Labor Union and have their own challenges because it could not be carried out face-to-face due to restrictions according to health protocols during the COVID-19 pandemic. The negotiations could only be carried out in a hybrid manner, with a limited number of face-to-face participants while other participants took part virtually. The other reason for the meeting is also because of the issuance of new manpower laws and regulations, namely Law of the Republic of Indonesia No. 11 of 2020 concerning Job Creation and its derivatives, which include among others: (a) Government of the Republic of Indonesia Regulation No. 35 of 2021 concerning Employment Agreement for a Specific Period of Time, Outsourcing, Working Time and Rest Time, and Termination of Employment; and (b) Government of the Republic of Indonesia Regulation No. 36 of 2021 concerning Wages.

## Meetings with the Labor Union

The relationship between the Company and the Labor Union is well maintained and harmonious on an ongoing basis because the Labor Union understands its important role as a partner of the Company which provides support in achieving the Company's goals and improving employee welfare.

The Labor Union has the Liberty to propose meetings with Company representatives at a time that is convenient for both parties. In the meeting, the Labor Union officials may convey their input, aspirations, or even requests from employees, and vice versa, the Company may also convey information regarding things that deserve attention from the Union as the employees' representatives.

Perundingan PKB kali ini terdiri dari 7 orang perwakilan dari Perusahaan dan 15 orang perwakilan dari Serikat Pekerja dan memiliki tantangan tersendiri karena tidak dapat dilakukan dengan tatap muka oleh seluruh tim perunding terkait pembatasan sesuai protokol kesehatan selama pandemi COVID-19. Perundingan hanya dapat dilakukan secara hybrid dengan peserta tatap muka pada jumlah terbatas dan sebagian peserta lainnya mengikuti secara virtual. Hal lainnya juga disebabkan oleh terbitnya peraturan perundangan yang baru di bidang ketenagakerjaan, yakni Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia No. 11 Tahun 2020 tentang Cipta Kerja beserta turunannya yang antara lain: (a) Peraturan Pemerintah Republik Indonesia No. 35 Tahun 2021 tentang Perjanjian Kerja Waktu Tertentu, Alih Daya, Waktu Kerja dan Waktu Istirahat, dan Pemutusan Hubungan Kerja; dan (b) Peraturan Pemerintah Republik Indonesia No. 36 Tahun 2021 tentang Pengupahan.

# Challenges and actions towards sustainability implementation

As our production levels are projected to grow, achieving our total waste reduction target becomes a challenge. Our core value "passion for innovation" had pushed us to innovate our ways and activities from the product formulation to the production stage. We have revisited our testing processes in order to expedite the process and reduce the unnecessary use of reagents during the analysis process. We also have been innovating on ways to reduce product and packaging rejections by making more durable and element resistant packaging. Considering the environmental factors and the process from product distribution and storage, we have noted the common cause of product damage and spoilage and we have made our product packaging adaptable to those factors.

We are also performing a pre-treatment process to reduce our toxic waste output. Our pre-treatment activities resulted in a significant reduction of our toxic waste output.

This increase in production level comes with the corresponding increase in energy consumption. We perform constant facility and equipment maintenance in order to ensure that emissions our facilities and equipment are at the minimum. We have also explored options for renewable energy, currently we have engaged a vendor to start the installation of solar panels in our factory.

Soho Global Health is committed towards having a sound integrated corporate governance, which includes the topic of environment, social and governance. # Recognizing and Respecting Employees' Rights
Mengakui dan Menghormati Hak-Hak Karyawan

## Recruitment Process

Employee recruitment is a process of searching, finding, and selecting candidates to meet the needs of human resources in a company. The function of recruitment is to ensure that human resource needs are met in accordance with the qualifications for the position so as to support smooth work processes in all business units.

Recruitment begins with employee requests from business units, which become a basis for the recruiter to start the candidates sourcing, both internally and externally. In the process of candidates sourcing, the SGH recruitment team does not discriminate against candidates based on ethnicity, religion and race; citizenship; gender; age; disability; political views; and other personal information, but prioritizes the skills and competencies needed in the intended field of work.

SGH uses several methods in candidates sourcing, including walk-in interviews and virtual job fairs. In 2022, we have conducted walk-in interviews in Jakarta, Semarang and Surabaya. The purpose of this activity is not only to speed up the recruitment process, but also to introduce SGH to the public, so that the Company's needs for resources can be met immediately. We also have an internship program and accepted the "Professional Work Practice Programs for Pharmacists" in collaboration with several universities in Indonesia. This certainly provides an opportunity for students to be able to get to know the work environment, so that when they have completed their studies they are expected to be able to apply their knowledge during internship and work practices program.

Another method of candidates sourcing is using social media. In addition to sharing information about job vacancies, we have also posted people activities and various information from the Company that are intended for the public.

## Proses Rekrutmen

Perekrutan karyawan adalah proses mencari, menemukan, dan menyeleksi kandidat untuk memenuhi kebutuhan Sumber Daya Manusia (SDM) di sebuah Perusahaan. Fungsi rekrutmen adalah memastikan kebutuhan SDM terpenuhi sesuai kualifikasi jabatan sehingga mendukung kelancaran proses kerja di seluruh unit bisnis.

Rekrutmen dimulai dengan permintaan kebutuhan karyawan dari unit bisnis, yang menjadi dasar bagi team rekrutmen memulai proses pencarian kandidat, baik internal maupun eksternal. Dalam proses pencarian kandidat, team rekrutmen SGH tidak membeda-bedakan kandidat berdasarkan Suku, Agama dan Ras (SARA), kewarganegaraan, jenis kelamin, usia, disabilitas, pandangan politik, maupun informasi personal lainnya, namun mengutamakan keterampilan dan kompetensi yang diperlukan di bidang pekerjaan yang dituju.

SGH menggunakan beberapa metode dalam proses pencarian kandidat, di antaranya walk-in interview dan virtual job fair. Pada tahun 2022, kami melakukan walk-in interview di Jakarta, Semarang dan Surabaya. Tujuan dari aktivitas ini selain untuk mempercepat proses rekrutmen, juga untuk memperkenalkan SGH ke masyarakat, sehingga kebutuhan SDM Perusahaan dapat segera terpenuhi. Kami juga memiliki program pemagangan dan menerima Praktek Kerja Profesi Apoteker (PKPA) yang bekerjasama dengan beberapa Universitas di Indonesia. Hal ini tentunya memberikan kesempatan kepada pelajar dan mahasiswa untuk dapat mengenal dunia kerja, sehingga saat sudah menyelesaikan studinya, mereka diharapkan dapat mengaplikasikan ilmu yang telah diperoleh sebelumnya selama program pemagangan dan praktek kerja.

Metode lainnya dalam pencarian kandidat adalah memanfaatkan media sosial. Selain membagikan informasi mengenai lowongan pekerjaan, kami juga membagikan aktivitas Karyawan serta berbagai informasi dari Perusahaan kepada publik lewat media sosial.

As the final stage in the employee recruitment process, we always ensure that candidates have a good health record based on the results of their pre-employment medical check-up and ensure they have received the COVID-19 vaccine. This is of course the company's effort to maintain occupational health and safety for all employees.

## Employee selection and benefits

We hire and incentivize people based on sole skills and capabilities. Ethnicity, religion, weight, appearance and gender are never a factor in our hiring and compensation criteria. Further, we have a strict policy and background check to filter hiring minors.

We did not have employee lay off during the pandemic since all positions and personnel in our roster have important roles in the company regardless of level, because job description and roles are well defined. Further, we provided financial support for our employees and/or their families that have been hit by the virus.

# Human Rights

As a company engaged in the health care industry, SGH believes that business has a responsibility to respect human rights and consistently makes every effort to uphold human rights within the company. Therefore, the company has a policy as a guideline for all employees to respect and prioritize human rights as an inseparable right and uphold for the sake of honor and protection of human dignity in relations between employees, external parties and society.

The Company is committed that human rights violations are illegal and we have zero-tolerance on it. The company makes every effort to ensure that there is no discrimination or business practices that are contrary to human rights, and takes steps to identify and prevent risks of human rights violations in business. During 2022 there were no human rights violation case at SGH, either by employees or external parties.

The company's efforts to protect human rights among others:

01. Prohibition of Child Labor

The company prohibits to employ children under the age of 18 (eighteen) years, and this minimum age is used as requirement in recruitment

02. Prohibition of Forced Labor and Human Trafficking

The company prohibits all forms of forced labor practices, including forced contract workers, modern forced labor, and all forms of human trafficking

03. Prohibition of Harassment and Intimidation

All levels of management and Employees are prohibited from discriminating against Employees who file complaints of harassment and intimidation. The company and its Employees are committed and responsible for preventing acts of harassment and intimidation by maintaining good and productive industrial relations, socialization of policy and regulations applicable to the company, fair employment practices and respectful communication in the workplace

# Hak Asasi Manusia

Sebagai perusahaan yang bergerak di industri kesehatan, SGH meyakini bahwa bisnis memiliki tanggung jawab dalam menghormati Hak Asasi Manusia (HAM) dan secara konsisten mendukung upaya-upaya penegakan HAM di lingkungan Perusahaan. Oleh karena itu perusahaan memiliki kebijakan khusus yang digunakan sebagai pedoman bagi seluruh karyawan untuk menghormati dan mengedepankan HAM sebagai hak yang tidak terpisahkan dari manusia dan ditegakkan demi kehormatan serta perlindungan harkat dan martabat manusia dalam hubungan antar karyawan, pihak eksternal serta masyarakat sekitar.

Perusahaan berkomitmen bahwa pelanggaran HAM merupakan tindakan ilegal dan tidak dapat ditolerir (zero-tolerance). Perusahaan berupaya maksimal untuk memastikan tidak terjadi diskriminasi ataupun praktik bisnis yang bertentangan dengan HAM, serta mengambil langkah-langkah untuk mengidentifikasi dan mencegah risiko pelanggaran HAM dalam bisnis. Selama tahun 2022 tidak terjadi pelanggaran HAM di SGH, baik oleh karyawan maupun pihak eksternal.

Langkah-langkah perusahaan dalam melindungi HAM antara lain meliputi:

01. Larangan Tenaga Kerja Anak

Perusahaan melarang mempekerjakan anak di bawah usia 18 (delapan belas) tahun, dan batasan usia ini dijadikan sebagai syarat minimal usia penerimaan karyawan

02. Larangan Kerja Paksa dan Jual Beli Manusia

Perusahaan melarang segala bentuk praktek kerja paksa, termasuk tenaga kontrak paksa, model perbudakan modern dan segala bentuk jual beli manusia

03. Larangan Tindakan Pelecehan dan Intimidasi

Seluruh jajaran manajemen dan karyawan dilarang melakukan diskriminasi terhadap Karyawan yang mengajukan pengaduan terjadinya tindakan Pelecehan dan Intimidasi. Perusahaan dan karyawan berkomitmen dan bertanggung jawab untuk mencegah terjadinya tindakan pelecehan dan intimidasi dengan cara menjaga hubungan industrial yang baik dan produktif, sosialisasi kebijakan dan peraturan yang berlaku di perusahaan, praktik ketenagakerjaan yang adil dan komunikasi penuh hormat di tempat kerja

The company is also committed to respecting labor rights as a manifestation of human rights for employees, namely:

a. Fulfilling employment rights
b. Respect the work relationship with Employees, especially in terms of clarity of Employee status, job placement, acceptance of new employees, mutation, rotations, promotions, and demotions
c. Respect the right of Employees to have good health, clear working days and hours, opportunities for sick leave, menstrual leave, maternity leave, miscarriage, collective leave, and annual leave
d. Providing equal and non-discriminatory opportunities, as well as respecting diversity and inclusion
e. Respect the rights of employees to freedom of association and gathering, and negotiation through unions or workers representatives
f. Provide social facilities to all employees based on the company's capabilities
g. Provide a workplace that is free from all forms of harassment and intimidation, as well as facilitating the employees to submit and resolve grievances
h. Ensure the health and safety of Employees by providing a safe, healthy, and productive workplace

The Company also expects external parties and other stakeholders to participate in the company's commitments regarding human rights and encourage them to implement the same policies within their respective companies.

## Emission Control

Soho Global Health uses boilers in its business and factory production activities that emit Nitrate Dioxide (NO₂), Sulphur Dioxide (SO₂), and other particulates. The emissions released are the result of burning fossil fuels and can disrupt the environmental quality and human health. Realizing this, we control our emissions by increasing the effectiveness of our boiler performance.

We also use environmentally friendly refrigerants in our air conditioning in the factories, warehouses and offices. Environmentally friendly materials are also being used with minimal ozone depletion potential (ODP) levels.

Other emission control efforts carried out include vehicle emission testing by the local Transportation Agency. Test results in 2021 showed that all our operational vehicles have passed the emission tests, and confirmed that the emission levels were below the threshold.

## Kontrol Emisi

Soho Global Health menggunakan ketel uap dalam kegiatan bisnis dan produksi pabriknya yang mengeluarkan Nitrat Dioksida (NO₂), Sulfur Dioksida (SO₂), dan partikulat lainnya. Emisi yang dikeluarkan merupakan hasil pembakaran bahan bakar fosil dan dapat mengganggu kualitas lingkungan dan kesehatan manusia. Menyadari hal tersebut, kami mengontrol emisinya dengan meningkatkan efektivitas kinerja ketel uapnya.

Kami juga menggunakan pendingin ramah lingkungan dalam pendingin udara di pabrik, gudang dan kantor. Bahan ramah lingkungan juga digunakan dengan tingkat potensi penipisan ozon (ODP) yang minimal.

Upaya pengendalian emisi lainnya yang dilakukan antara lain uji emisi kendaraan oleh Dinas Perhubungan setempat. Hasil pengujian pada tahun 2021 menunjukkan bahwa semua kendaraan operasional kami telah lulus uji emisi, dan dipastikan kadar emisinya berada di bawah ambang batas.

As part of our commitment to product safety and in compliance with regulatory requirement, we have a pharmacovigilance reporting system. All reports of adverse event received must be reported to the pharmacovigilance team within 24 hours verbally and/or in writing via email at pv@sohoglobalhealth.com. The Company will follow up on complaints from the public/consumers and monitor the status of the settlement.

In 2022, there were 12 undesirable event reports received. These complaints have been investigated and followed up according to applicable procedures, these complaints were generally non-serious events related to mild allergic reactions and digestive disorders. After stopping the use of the product, the negative reactions gradually disappeared, and the patient's condition improved.

## Safety Evaluated Products/Services for Customers

We are committed to providing and offering good quality and safe products for customers. Before being distributed to the market, all products have gone through various stages of very strict evaluation by the National Agency of Drug and Food Control (BPOM) so that these products are guaranteed in terms of safety, efficacy, and quality. We ensure that every product to be distributed has passed the evaluation and has obtained a distribution permit from BPOM. Each production batch that is circulated has met the requirements for testing, monitoring, and product release carried out by our Quality Assurance (QA) Division. In addition, we also carry out routine pharmacovigilance activities for products that have been circulated to the market. Pharmacovigilance activities aim to monitor side effects and unwanted events that may occur due to the use of the product.

## Product Recall

In 2021, we have initiated 1 voluntary product recall due to the darkening of one of our tablet products. For this, we have taken adequate action and conducted a recall to investigate the change in coloration, if it may lead to a more serious concern. There were no health and safety incident that occurred prior and after the recall.

## Seed to patient process

We continuously innovate in various aspects. One of the things that was done related to our product development was to make a breakthrough in curcuma-based herbal medicine, starting from providing quality extract raw materials, testing the efficacy and safety in manufacturing the final product, to product innovation with better technology.

With 2 innovation concepts, namely the Seed to Patient concept and the collaboration concept of 4 components: Academic, Business, Government, and Community (ABGC). We have advantages in terms of controlled quality, proven usefulness and wide impact. In an effort to increase our independence of procuring superior quality raw materials, we came up with a Seed to Patient concept where every stage of the process is strictly controlled.

One of the technological innovations implemented is through the addition of piperine formulations to increase the bioavailability of curcuma. The technological innovation of the piperine formula in curcuma received the Rintisan Teknologi Award (RINTEK) 2021 from the Ministry of Industry.

Sebagai bagian dari komitmen kami terhadap keamanan produk dan sesuai dengan persyaratan peraturan, kami memiliki sistem pelaporan farmakovigilans. Semua laporan efek samping yang diterima perusahaan harus dilaporkan kepada tim farmakovigilans dalam waktu 24 jam secara lisan dan/atau tertulis melalui email pv@sohoglobalhealth.com. Perseroan akan menindaklanjuti pengaduan dari masyarakat/ konsumen dan dimonitor status penyelesaiannya.

Pada tahun 2022, terdapat 12 keluhan yang diterima terkait kejadian tidak dinginkan. Keluhan-keluhan tersebut telah diinvestigasi dan ditindaklanjuti sesuai prosedur yang berlaku, dimana keluhan-keluhan tersebut pada umumnya adalah kejadian tidak diinginkan yang bersifat non serius terkait dengan reaksi alergi dan gangguan pencernaan yang bersifat ringan. Setelah menghentikan penggunaan produk, keluhan tersebut berangsur-angsur hilang dan kondisi pasien membaik.

## Produk/Jasa yang Sudah Dievaluasi Keamanannya bagi Pelanggan

Kami berkomitmen untuk menyediakan dan menawarkan produk yang berkualitas baik dan aman bagi para pelanggan. Sebelum diedarkan ke pasar, semua produk telah melalui berbagai tahapan evaluasi yang sangat ketat oleh Badan POM sehingga produk tersebut terjamin secara keamanan, efikasi, dan mutu. Kami memastikan bahwa setiap produk yang akan diedarkan telah lulus evaluasi dan telah memperoleh surat izin edar dari Badan POM. Setiap betis produksi yang diedarkan telah memenuhi persyaratan untuk pengujian, pengawasan, dan perilisan produk yang dilakukan oleh Divisi Pemastian Mutu (Quality Assurance, QA). Selain itu, kami turut melakukan kegiatan farmakovigilans secara rutin untuk produk-produk yang telah diedarkan ke pasar. Aktivitas farmakovigilans bertujuan untuk melakukan monitoring efek samping dan kejadian tidak diinginkan yang mungkin terjadi akibat penggunaan produk.

## Produk yang Ditarik Kembali

Pada tahun 2021, kami telah memulai 1 penarikan produk secara sukarela karena salah satu produk tablet kami yang warnanya menjadi gelap. Untuk ini, kami telah mengambil tindakan yang memadai dan melakukan penarikan untuk menyelidiki perubahan warna, jika dapat menyebabkan masalah yang lebih serius. Tidak ada insiden kesehatan dan keselamatan yang terjadi sebelum dan sesudah penarikan.

## Proses Seed to Patient

Kami terus melakukan inovasi pada berbagai aspek. Salah satu yang dilakukan terkait pengembangan produk kami mengadakan terobosan pada obat herbal berbasis temulawak, mulai dari penyediaan bahan baku ekstrak yang berkualitas, pengujian khasiat, dan keamanan pembuatan produk akhir, hingga inovasi produk dengan teknologi yang lebih baik.

Dengan 2 konsep inovasi yang dilakukan yakni konsep Proses seed to patient dan konsep kolaborasi 4 komponen: Academic, Business, Government, dan Community (ABGC). Kami memiliki keunggulan dalam hal kualitas yang terkontrol, teruji berdaya manfaat serta berdampak luas. Dalam usaha meningkatkan kemandirian pengadaan bahan baku yang berkualitas unggul, obat herbal kami memiliki konsep Proses seed to patient dimana setiap tahapan proses dikontrol dengan ketat.

Salah satu inovasi terknologi yang diterapkan adalah melalui formulasi penambahan piperine guna meningkatkan bioavailabilitas curcuma. Inovasi teknologi formula piperine pada curcuma tersebut mendapatkan penghargaan Rintisan Teknologi (RINTEK) 2021 dari Kementerian Perindustrian.

Our innovations on sustainability was also applied to other products and has also received recognition through various innovation awards, including the Curcuma Plus group product as the number 1 child immunity product in Indonesia (Outstanding Corporate Innovation (OCI) Gold Award 2017); Imboost product group as immunomodulator supplements with the largest sales growth in 2018 (Innovative Industrial Research & Development Institution (IIRDI) Award 2018); Quidfast technology as a new Drug Delivery System (DDS) for Asthin product group (Innovative Industrial Research & Development Institution (IIRDI) Award 2019); Glucodiab Drink and Diapet in an effort to handle Covid-19 (Penghargaan Anugerah Industri Inovatif 2020).

We implement green technology in carrying out business processes. The application of green technology applied includes maximizing the use of extracted waste to become compost which is used in the Curcuma plantation of the SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) as organic fertilizer, and since 2017 SCEHR has also been certified organic from the Indonesian Organic Farming Certification.

Innovations in the product development process with green technology include the use of water-based coating media and no longer using organic solvent-based coating media. The comprehensive implementation of the water-based coating media on our products was able to reduce 100% of the impact of the risk of organic solvent contamination on the environment and also the risk of exposure to organic solvents of our employees.

Continuous innovation in the production process involves the application of environmentally friendly technology wherein the herbal extraction process is carried out with environmentally friendly solvents (not organic solvents) and the application of solvent recovery and reuse. It was able to reduce the use and waste of solvents by more than 25%.

Innovation in marketing and sales processes is carried out by utilizing technology, information and communication. The use of digital selling and store information and promotion also plays a role in increasing the effectiveness of the marketing process and growing our product sales. After-sales service is also carried out by utilizing technology, information and communication through various available media such as online media, social media and print media.

SOHO Global Health also implements a Continued Improvement program where every individual can innovate and make contributions which have positive impact on the continuity of the company's business processes. The implementation of the Continued Improvement program has also become a solid basis for SOHO to continue to innovate in various aspects related to technology, environment, finance and society.

## Product information

We subject our products to series of test and assessment, including obtaining permits and approvals from regulators before releasing products to the public. All product packaging have clear information about our products which includes; (a) product content; (b) effects and possible side effects of the product; (c) proper storage and handling. These information are important since each person have different reaction to substances.

Our products are mainly supplements, thus there is minimal to no adverse impact in consuming our products. None the less we are being transparent and providing the necessary information to our consumers.

Inovasi kami yang berkesinambungan juga diterapkan pada produk-produk lainnya dan juga telah mendapatkan pengakuan melalui berbagai penghargaan inovasi, diantaranya adalah pada produk Curcuma Plus group sebagai produk imunitas anak nomor 1 di Indonesia (Outstanding Corporate Innovation (OCI) Gold Award 2017); Produk Imboost group sebagai supplement immunomodulator dengan pertumbuhan penjualan terbesar pada tahun 2018 (Innovative Industrial Research & Development Institution (IIRDI) Award 2018); Quidfast teknologi sebagai new Drug Delivery System (DDS) pada produk Asthin group (Innovative Industrial Research & Development Institution (IIRDI) Award 2019); Glucodiab Drink dan Diapet dalam upaya penanganan Covid-19 (Penghargaan Anugerah Industri Inovatif 2020).

Kami melakukan penerapan teknologi ramah lingkungan dalam melakukan proses bisnis. Penerapan teknologi ramah lingkungan yang diterapkan antara lain dengan memaksimalkan penggunaan limbah hasil ektraksi untuk menjadi kompos yang digunakan di kebun temulawak SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) sebagai pupuk organik, dan sejak 2017 SCEHR pun telah tersertifikat organik dari Lembaga Sertifikasi Pertanian Organik.

Inovasi pada proses pengembangan produk dengan teknologi ramah lingkungan mencakup penggunaan media coating berbasis air dan tidak lagi menggunakan media coating berbasis pelarut organik. Implementasi media coating berbasis air tersebut secara menyeluruh pada produk-produk kami mampu mengurangi 100% dampak risiko pencemaran pelarut organik pada lingkungan dan juga risiko paparan pelarut organik pada sumber daya manusia kami.

Inovasi berkesinambungan pada proses produksi melibatkan penerapan teknologi ramah lingkungan dimana untuk proses ekstraksi herbal dilakukan pelarut yang ramah lingkungan (bukan pelarut organik) dan juga penerapan pemulihan dan penggunaan kembali pelarut. Hal tersebut mampu mengurangi pemakaian dan limbah pelarut lebih dari 25%.

Inovasi pada proses pemasaran dan penjualan dilakukan dengan memanfaatkan teknologi, informasi, dan komunikasi. Pemanfaatan penjualan dan informasi promosi toko digital juga ikut berperan dalam meningkatkan efektivitas proses pemasaran dan pertumbuhan penjualan produk-produk kami. Pelayanan purna jual juga dilakukan dengan memanfaatkan teknologi, informasi dan komunikasi melalui berbagai media yang tersedia seperti media online, media sosial, dan media cetak.

SOHO Global Health juga menerapkan program peningkatan keberlanjutan dimana setiap individu dapat berinovasi dan berkontribusi yang memberikan dampak positif bagi kelangsungan proses bisnis perusahaan. Penerapan program peningkatan keberlanjutan pun menjadi dasar yang kokoh bagi SOHO untuk terus berinovasi pada berbagai aspek terkait teknologi, lingkungan, finansial, dan kemasyarakatan.

## Informasi produk

Kami membuat produk kami melalui serangkaian pengujian dan penilaian, termasuk memperoleh izin dan persetujuan dari regulator sebelum merilis produk ke publik. Semua kemasan produk memiliki informasi yang jelas tentang produk kami yang meliputi; (a) konten produk; (b) efek dan kemungkinan efek samping produk; (c) penyimpanan dan penanganan yang tepat. Informasi ini penting karena setiap orang memiliki reaksi yang berbeda terhadap suatu zat.

Produk kami sebagian besar adalah suplemen, sehingga minimal atau tidak ada dampak buruk dalam mengonsumsi produk kami. Meskipun demikian, kami bersikap transparan dan memberikan informasi yang diperlukan kepada konsumen kami.

## Impairment of trade receivables

### Description of the key audit matter:

As of December 31, 2022, the Group recognized trade receivables of Rp1.2 trillion, which represents 27% of the Group's consolidated total assets. As described in Notes 2, 3 and 5 to the accompanying consolidated financial statements, the Group applied the simplified approach in calculating expected credit losses ("ECL") of trade receivables based on a provision matrix that in accordance with historical credit loss experience, aging analysis of trade receivables and adjusted for forward-looking information specific to the debtors and the economic environment. This impairment assessment of trade receivables is significant to our audit as it involves the exercise of significant management judgment and significant amount as described above.

1. UMUM

a. Pendirian Perusahaan

PT Soho Global Health Tbk (“Perusahaan”), didirikan di Jakarta berdasarkan Akta Notaris Elisa Pondaag, S.H., No. 116 tanggal 27 Agustus 1956 dengan nama PT Parit Padang. Akta Pendirian ini telah disahkan oleh Menteri Kehakiman Republik Indonesia dalam Surat Keputusan No. J.A.5/16/14 tanggal 8 Februari 1957, dan dipublikasi di Berita Negara Republik Indonesia No. 39, Tambahan No. 517 tanggal 14 Mei 1957.

Anggaran Dasar Perusahaan telah mengalami beberapa kali perubahan. Berdasarkan Akta Notaris yang dibuat di hadapan Notaris Jimmy Tanal, S.H., M.Kn., No. 123 tanggal 19 Juni 2020, Perusahaan merubah klasifikasi saham dari Seri A, B dan C menjadi satu klasifikasi saham biasa, yang memiliki hak yang sama. Amandemen ini juga mencakup perubahan modal dasar, modal ditempatkan dan modal disetor Perusahaan, yang semula memiliki (i) modal dasar sebesar Rp1.042.800 yang terdiri dari 84.854 saham Seri A dengan nilai nominal Rp250.000 (nilai penuh) per saham, 55.051 saham Seri B dengan nilai nominal Rp5.478.317 (nilai penuh) per saham dan 8.000 saham Seri C dengan nilai nominal Rp90.000.000 (nilai penuh) per saham menjadi modal dasar sebesar Rp1.042.810 yang terdiri dari 309.310 saham dengan nilai nominal nilai Rp3.371.408 (nilai penuh) per saham; dan (ii) modal ditempatkan dan disetor sebesar Rp357.939 yang terdiri dari 63.800 saham Seri A, 41.069 saham Seri B dan 1.300 saham Seri C menjadi Rp357.939 yang terdiri dari 106.169 saham.

1. GENERAL

a. Establishment of the Company

PT Soho Global Health Tbk (the “Company”), was established in Jakarta based on Notarial Deed No. 116 of Elisa Pondaag, S.H., dated August 27, 1956 under the name of PT Parit Padang. The Article of Association was approved by the Minister of Justice of the Republic of Indonesia in its decision letter No. J.A.5/16/14 dated February 8, 1957, and was published in the State Gazette No. 39, Supplement No. 517 dated May 14, 1957.

The Company's Articles of Association has been amended several times. Based on the Notarial Deed made before Notary Jimmy Tanal, S.H., M.Kn., No. 123 dated June 19, 2020, the Company amended the share's classification from Series A, B and C, to become one single classification of ordinary shares which will have equal rights. This amendment also includes changes in the authorized capital, issued and paid-up capital of the Company, which initially has (i) authorized capital of Rp1,042,800 consisting of 84,854 Series A shares with nominal value of Rp250,000 (full amount) per share, 55,051 Series B shares with nominal value of Rp5,478,317 (full amount) per share and 8,000 Series C shares with nominal value of Rp90,000,000 (full amount) per share to authorized capital of Rp1,042,810 consisting of 309,310 shares with nominal value of Rp3,371,408 (full amount) per share; and (ii) issued and paid-up capital of Rp357,939 consisting of 63,800 Series A shares, 41,069 Series B shares and 1,300 Series C shares to Rp357,939 consisting of 106,169 shares.

e. Current and non-current classification

The Group presents assets and liabilities in the consolidated statement of financial position based on current/non-current classification. An asset is current when it is:

1) expected to be realized or intended to be sold or consumed in the normal operating cycle,
2) held primarily for the purpose of trading,
3) expected to be realized within 12 months after the reporting period, or
4) cash or cash equivalent unless restricted from being exchanged or used to settle a liability for at least 12 months after the reporting period.

All other assets are classified as non-current.

A liability is current when it is:

i) expected to be settled in the normal operating cycle,
ii) held primarily for the purpose of trading,
iii) due to be settled within 12 months after the reporting period, or
iv) there is no unconditional right to defer the settlement of the liability for at least 12 months after the reporting period.

All other liabilities are classified as non-current.

Deferred tax assets and liabilities are classified as non-current assets and liabilities.

f. Restrukturisasi antara entitas sepengendali

Dalam PSAK 38, "Akuntansi Restrukturisasi Entitas Sepengendali", pengalihan bisnis antara entitas sepengendali tidak mengakibatkan perubahan substansi ekonomi kepemilikan atas bisnis yang dialihkan dan tidak dapat menimbulkan laba atau rugi bagi Kelompok Usaha secara keseluruhan ataupun bagi entitas individual dalam Kelompok Usaha tersebut. Karena pengalihan bisnis antara entitas sepengendali tidak mengakibatkan perubahan substansi ekonomi, bisnis yang dipertukarkan dicatat pada nilai buku sebagai kombinasi bisnis dengan menggunakan metode penyatuan kepemilikan.

Dalam menerapkan metode penyatuan kepemilikan, komponen laporan keuangan dimana terjadi kombinasi bisnis dan untuk periode lain yang disajikan untuk tujuan perbandingan, disajikan sedemikian rupa seolah-olah kombinasi bisnis telah terjadi sejak awal periode terjadi sepengendalian.

Selisih antara nilai tercatat transaksi kombinasi bisnis dan jumlah imbalan yang dialihkan diakui dalam akun "Tambahan Modal Disetor".

g. Kombinasi bisnis

Kombinasi bisnis dicatat dengan menggunakan metode akuisisi. Biaya perolehan dari sebuah akuisisi diukur pada nilai agregat imbalan yang dialihkan, diukur pada nilai wajar pada tanggal akuisisi dan jumlah setiap KNP pada pihak yang diakuisisi. Untuk setiap kombinasi bisnis, Kelompok Usaha memilih apakah mengukur KNP pada entitas yang diakuisisi baik pada nilai wajar ataupun pada proporsi kepemilikan KNP atas aset neto yang teridentifikasi dari entitas yang diakuisisi. Biaya-biaya akuisisi yang timbul dibebankan langsung dan disertakan dalam beban administrasi.

f. Restructuring of entities under common control

Under PSAK 38, "Accounting for Restructuring Under Common Control Entities", transfer of business within entities under common control does not result in a change of the economic substance of ownership of the business being transferred and would not result in a gain or loss to the Group or to the individual entity within the Group. Since the transfer of business of entities under common control does not result in a change of the economic substance, the business being exchanged is recorded at book values as a business combination using the pooling-of-interests method.

In applying the pooling-of-interests method, the components of the financial statements or the period during which the restructuring occurred and for other periods presented, for comparison purposes, are presented in such a manner as if the restructuring has already happened since the beginning of the periods during which the entities were under common control.

The difference between the carrying amounts of the business combination transaction and the consideration transferred is recognized under the account "Additional Paid-in Capital".

g. Business combinations

Business combinations are accounted for using the acquisition method. The cost of an acquisition is measured as the aggregate of the consideration transferred, measured at acquisition date fair value and the amount of any NCI in the acquiree. For each business combination, the Group elects whether it measures the NCI in the acquiree either at fair value or at the proportionate share of the acquiree's identifiable net assets. Acquisition costs incurred are directly expensed and included in administrative expenses.

Ketika melakukan akuisisi atas sebuah bisnis, Kelompok Usaha mengklasifikasikan dan menentukan aset keuangan yang diperoleh dari liabilitas keuangan yang diambil alih berdasarkan pada persyaratan kontraktual, kondisi ekonomi dan kondisi terkait lain yang ada pada tanggal akuisisi.

Dalam suatu kombinasi bisnis yang dilakukan secara bertahap, Kelompok Usaha mengukur kembali kepentingan ekuitas yang dimiliki sebelumnya pada pihak yang diakuisisi pada nilai wajar tanggal akuisisi dan mengakui keuntungan atau kerugian yang dihasilkan.

Setiap imbalan kontinjensi yang akan ditransfer oleh perusahaan pengakuisisi akan diakui pada nilai wajar pada tanggal akuisisi. Imbalan kontinjensi yang diklasifikasikan sebagai ekuitas tidak diukur kembali dan penyelesaian selanjutnya adalah diperhitungkan dalam ekuitas. Imbalan kontinjensi yang diklasifikasikan sebagai aset atau liabilitas yaitu instrumen keuangan dan dalam lingkup PSAK 71, diukur pada nilai wajar dengan perubahan nilai wajar yang diakui dalam laporan laba rugi konsolidasian sesuai dengan PSAK 71. Imbalan kontinjensi lain yang tidak termasuk dalam PSAK 71 diukur sebesar nilai wajar pada setiap tanggal pelaporan dengan perubahan nilai wajar yang diakui pada laba rugi.

g. Business combinations (continued)

The Group determines that it has acquired a business when the acquired set of activities and assets include an input and a substantive process that together significantly contribute to the ability to create outputs. The acquired process is considered substantive if it is critical to the ability to continue producing outputs and the inputs acquired include an organized workforce with the necessary skills, knowledge, or experience to perform that process or it significantly contributes to the ability to continue producing outputs and is considered unique or scarce or cannot be replaced without significant cost, effort, or delay in the ability to continue producing outputs.

When the Group acquires a business, it assesses the financial assets acquired and liabilities assumed for appropriate classification and designation in accordance with the contractual terms, economic circumstances and pertinent conditions as at the acquisition date.

If the business combination is achieved in stages, the acquisition date fair value of the Group's previously held equity interest in the acquiree is remeasured to fair value at the acquisition date through profit or loss.

Any contingent consideration to be transferred by the acquirer will be recognized at fair value at the acquisition date. Contingent consideration classified as equity is not remeasured and its subsequent settlement is accounted for within equity. Contingent consideration classified as an asset or liability that is a financial instrument and within the scope of PSAK 71, is measured at fair value with the changes in fair value recognized in the consolidated statement of profit or loss in accordance with PSAK 71. Other contingent consideration that is not within the scope of PSAK 71 is measured at fair value at each reporting date with changes in fair value recognized in profit or loss.

g. Business combinations (continued)

If the initial accounting for a business combination is incomplete by the end of the reporting, the Group reports provisional amounts for the items for which the accounting is incomplete.

The measurement period is the period after the acquisition date during which the Group may adjust the provisional amounts recognized for a business combination. During the measurement period, the Group recognizes additional assets or liabilities if new information is obtained about facts and circumstances that existed as of the acquisition date and, if known, would have resulted in the recognition of those assets and liabilities as of that date.

The measurement period ends as soon as the acquirer receives the information it was seeking about facts and circumstances that existed as of the acquisition date or learns that more information is not obtainable but shall not exceed one year from the acquisition date.

At acquisition date, goodwill is initially measured at cost being the excess of the aggregate of the consideration transferred and the amount recognized for NCI over the net identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed.

If this consideration is lower than the fair value of the net assets of the subsidiary acquired, the difference is recognized in profit or loss as gain on bargain purchase after previously assessing the identification and fair value measurement of the acquired assets and the assumed liabilities.

After initial recognition, goodwill is measured at cost less any accumulated impairment losses. For the purpose of impairment testing, goodwill acquired in a business combination is, from the acquisition date, allocated to each of the Group's Cash-generating Units ("CGU") that are expected to benefit from the combination, irrespective of whether other assets or liabilities of the acquiree are assigned to those CGUs.

i. Fair value measurement

The Group measures financial assets and financial liabilities, at fair value at each reporting date. The Group also initially measures financial instruments, and assets and liabilities of the acquires upon business combinations at fair value. They also measure certain recoverable amounts of the cash generating unit (“CGU”) using fair value less cost of disposal (“FVLCD”) and certain financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income (“FVOCI”).

Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date. The fair value measurement is based on the presumption that the transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place either:

i) In the principal market for the asset or liability, or
ii) In the absence of a principal market, in the most advantageous market for the asset or liability.

The principal or the most advantageous market must be accessible to by the Group.

The fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using the assumptions that market participants would use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market participants act in their economic best interest.

Inventories are valued at the lower of cost or net realizable value. Cost is calculated using weighted-average method. Net realizable value is the estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business, less estimated costs of completion and the estimated costs necessary to make the sale.

Costs incurred in bringing each product to its present location and condition are accounted for as follow:
i) Raw materials, supporting and packaging materials: purchase cost;
ii) Finished goods and work in-process: cost of direct materials and labor and a proportion of manufacturing overheads based on normal operating capacity but excluding borrowing costs.

Finished goods and work in process include an appropriate allocation of fixed and variable factory overhead in addition to direct materials and labor. Net realizable value is the estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business, less the estimated cost necessary to make the sale.

The Group provides allowance for net realizable value of inventories based on periodic reviews of the physical conditions and net realizable values of the inventories.

k. Transactions with related parties

Group as a lessee (continued)

i) Right of use assets

The Group recognizes right of use assets at the commencement date of the lease (i.e., the date the underlying asset is available for use). Right of use assets are measured at cost, less any accumulated depreciation and impairment losses, and adjusted for any remeasurement of lease liabilities. The cost of right of use assets includes the amount of lease liabilities recognized, initial direct costs incurred, and lease payments made at or before the commencement date less any lease incentives received. Right of use assets are depreciated on a straight-line basis over the lease term.

If ownership of the leased asset transfers to the Group at the end of the lease term or the cost reflects the exercise of a purchase option, depreciation is calculated using the estimated useful life of the asset. The right of use assets are also assessed for impairment.

ii) Lease liabilities

At the commencement date of the lease, the Group recognizes lease liabilities measured at the present value of lease payments to be made over the lease term.

The lease payments also include the exercise price of a purchase option reasonably certain to be exercised by the Group and payments of penalties for terminating the lease, if the lease term reflects exercising the option to terminate. Variable lease payments that do not depend on an index or a rate are recognized as expenses in the period in which the event or condition that triggers the payment occurs.

ii) Lease liabilities (continued)

In calculating the present value of lease payments, the Group uses its Incremental Borrowing Rate ("IBR") at the lease commencement date because the interest rate implicit in the lease is not readily determinable. The Group applies the short-term lease recognition exemption to its short-term leases (i.e., those leases that have a lease term of 12 months or less from the commencement date and do not contain a purchase option). An asset's recoverable amount is the higher of
an asset's or CGU's fair value less costs to sell
and its value in use, and is determined for an
individual asset, unless the asset does not
generate cash inflows that are largely
independent of those from other assets or groups
of assets. Where the carrying amount of an asset
or CGU exceeds its recoverable amount, the
asset is considered impaired and is written down
to its recoverable amount.

The Group bases its impairment calculation on
detailed budgets and forecast calculations which
are prepared separately for each of the Group's
CGUs to which the individual assets are
allocated. These budgets and forecast
calculations are generally covering a period of
five or ten years in accordance with the stability
of each estate's cash flows. Beyond the
forecasted period, the estimated cash flows are
determined by extrapolating the forecasted cash
flows using a steady long term growth rate.

In assessing the value in use, the estimated net
future cash flows are discounted to their present
value using a pre-tax discount rate that reflects
current market assessments of the time value of
money and the risks specific to the asset. In
determining fair value less costs to sell, recent
market transactions are taken into account, if
available. If no such transactions can be
identified, an appropriate valuation model is used
to determine the fair value of the assets. These
calculations are corroborated by valuation
multiples or other available fair value indicators.

Setelah pembalikan tersebut, penyusutan aset tersebut disesuaikan di periode mendatang untuk mengalokasikan jumlah tercatat aset yang direvisi, dikurangi nilai sisanya, dengan dasar yang sistematis selama sisa umur manfaatnya.

p. Impairment of non-financial assets

Impairment losses of continuing operations, if any, are recognized in the profit or loss in those expense categories consistent with the functions of the impaired asset.

For assets excluding goodwill, an assessment is made at each reporting date as to whether there is any indication that previously recognized impairment losses may no longer exist or may have decreased. If such indication exists, the asset's or CGU's recoverable amount is estimated. A previously recognized impairment loss for an asset other than goodwill is reversed only if there has been a change in the assumptions used to determine the asset's recoverable amount since the last impairment loss was recognized. If that is the case, the carrying amount of the asset is increased to its recoverable amount. The reversal is limited so that the carrying amount of the assets does not exceed its recoverable amount, nor exceed the carrying amount that would have been determined, net of depreciation, had no impairment loss been recognized for the asset in prior periods/years. Reversal of an impairment loss is recognized in the profit or loss. After such a reversal, the depreciation charge on the said asset is adjusted in future periods to allocate the asset's revised carrying amount, less any residual value, on a systematic basis over its remaining useful life.

t. Taxation (continued)

Current tax

Current income tax assets and liabilities for the current period are measured at the amount expected to be recovered from or paid to the taxation authority. Corporate current tax expense is determined based on the taxable profit for the year computed using the prevailing tax rates. Underpayment/overpayment of income tax is presented as part of Corporate income tax expense, net in the consolidated statements of profit or loss and other comprehensive income. The Group also presented interest/penalty, if any, as part of Corporate Income Tax Expense - Current. Amendments to tax obligations are recorded when a tax assessment letter is received or, if appealed against, when the result of the appeal is determined.

Deferred Tax

Deferred tax assets and liabilities are recognized using the liability method for the future tax consequences attributable to differences between the carrying amounts of existing assets and liabilities in the consolidated financial statements and their respective tax bases at each reporting date. Deferred tax liabilities are recognized for all taxable temporary differences and deferred tax assets are recognized for deductible temporary differences and accumulated fiscal losses to the extent that it is probable that taxable profit will be available in future years against which the deductible temporary differences and accumulated fiscal losses can be utilized.

The carrying amount of a deferred tax asset is reviewed at the end of each reporting period and reduced to the extent that it is no longer probable that sufficient taxable profit will be available to allow the benefit of part or all of that deferred tax asset to be utilized. At the end of each reporting period, the Group reassesses unrecognized deferred tax assets. The Group recognizes a previously unrecognized deferred tax assets to the extent that it has become probable that future taxable profit will allow the deferred tax assets to be recovered.

Berdasarkan siaran pers, Kelompok Usaha telah mengubah kebijakan akuntansinya untuk mengatribusikan imbalan berdasarkan program tersebut, yaitu dari tanggal ketika jasa pekerja pertama kali menghasilkan imbalan dalam program sampai dengan tanggal ketika jasa pekerja selanjutnya tidak akan menghasilkan jumlah imbalan yang material di bawah program tersebut. Karena perubahan kebijakan akuntansi ini, pada tanggal 1 Januari 2022, liabilitas imbalan kerja karyawan menurun sebesar Rp8.282, yang dianggap tidak material bagi Kelompok Usaha sehingga efeknya dibebankan pada laporan laba rugi dan penghasilan komprehensif lain konsolidasian tahun berjalan.

v. Research and development costs

An intangible asset arising from development expenditures on an individual project is recognized only when the Group can demonstrate: (i) the technical feasibility of completing the intangible asset so that it will be available for use or sale, (ii) its intention to complete and its ability to use or sell the asset, (iii) how the asset will generate future economic benefits, (iv) the availability of resources to complete and (v) the ability to measure reliably of the expenditures during the development.
